{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"簡命舊臣明於星學、數學者，在","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126141476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"詔大學士李光地等重為考定，以成是編。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126174244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"凡分六","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"目：一曰象數考原，二曰年神方位，三曰月事","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神，四曰月事凶神，五曰日時總𩔖，六月用","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"事宜忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126190628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"每一目為一卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126207012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"考古者外事用剛日，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126223396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748461102563365"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"内事用柔日，其日以卜不以擇。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126239780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"趙岐孟子註，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126256164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"天時為孤虚王相，則戰國時巳漸講之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126256164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"然神","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126272548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"煞之説，則莫知所起。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126272548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"易緯乾鑿度有太乙行","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126288932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫法。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126288932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙，天之貴神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126305316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"漢志兵家隂陽𩔖","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"亦稱順時而發，推刑徳，隨斗擊，因五勝，假鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"神而為助。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126321700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"又隂陽家𩔖稱出於羲和之官。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126338084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"拘","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"者為之，則牽于禁忌，拘于小數，舍人事而任","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126354468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"則神煞之説，自漢代巳盛行矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126370852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"夫鬼神","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126387236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109675554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎二氣，二氣化為五行，以相生相尅為用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126387236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"得其相生之氣，則其神吉；得其相尅之氣，則","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126403620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"其神凶，此亦自然之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126403620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"至其神各命以名，雖","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126420004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"似乎無稽，然物本無名，凡名皆人之所加。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126420004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126436388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"周天列宿，各有其名，亦人所加，非所本有。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126436388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"則","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂某神某神，不過假以記其方位，别其性","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"情而巳，不必以詞害意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126452772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"厯代方技之家，所","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"傳不一，輾轉附益，其説愈繁，要以不悖于隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109691938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之理者近是。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126469156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"是書簡汰諸家，删其鄙倍，","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126485540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"而括其綱要，于以順天之道，宜民之用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126485540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"大聖人之于百姓，事事欲其趨利而逺害，誠無微","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126501924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"之不至矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126501924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"乾隆四十六年十月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"7679048006126518308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：立天之道，曰隂與陽；立地之道，曰柔與剛。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689470504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人紀","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之正，協剛柔之宜，治厯明時，以調天地之化，欽若","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"授時，在齊七政，其來尚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689486888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"然有天地之形焉，有天地之","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689503272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"運焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689503272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"以形言之，書傳引渾天之說曰：天之形如鳥卵，地","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689519656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618857801914351642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"居其中，天包地外，如卵之裹黃，圓如彈丸，故曰渾天，言","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689519656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"其形渾渾如也。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689519656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：天包地外，地處天中，故天之形，","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689536040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"半覆地上，半繞地下，而左旋不息。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689536040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"其樞紐不動之處，為","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689552424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"南北極。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689552424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"今按周天三百六十度，分為十二宫，地周亦三","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689568808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"百六十度，而在天一度者，在地二百里，以定北極出地","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689568808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"之髙下，日出入之後先，節氣時刻之早晚，則天誠渾圓，","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689568808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"地亦渾圓也。","logicSentenceId":"7679046842689568808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"以運言之，蔡氏書傳曰：天體至圓，周圍三","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228376116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"百六十五度四分度之一，繞地左旋，一日一週而過一","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228376116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748501426307082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"度。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228392500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"日麗天而少遲，故日行一日，亦繞地一週，而不及天","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228408884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"一度。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228408884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"月麗天而尤遲，一日不及天十三度十九分度之","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228425268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"七。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228425268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：厯家算所退之度，却云日行一度，月行十三","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228441652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"度有竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228441652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃截法，故有日月五星右行之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228458036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"史伯璿曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228474420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"天非有體也，二十八宿與衆經星即其體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228474420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八宿","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228490804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"與衆經星繞地左旋，一晝一夜而一週。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228490804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"日月亦與之同","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228507188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"運，但不及其健，則漸退而反似右耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228507188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，天分九重，第","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"一重為月天；第二重為水星，亦曰辰星；第三重為金星，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748453892440127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"亦曰太白；第四重為日天；第五重為火星，亦曰熒惑；第","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"六重為木星，亦曰嵗星；第七重為土星，亦曰鎮星；第八","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"重為三垣二十八宿，謂之恆星，亦謂之經星；第九重為","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"宗動天。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228523572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"宗動左旋，日月星右轉，高則愈遲，低則愈疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228539956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228556340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"月一月而一週天，金水與日皆一嵗而一週天，火二嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228556340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"而一週天，木十二嵗而一週天，土二十八嵗而一週天。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228556340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"經星每年東行五十一秒，是為嵗差，以為推算之術。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228572724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228589108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"七政厯以土木火金水為次，以高卑遲疾為次者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228589108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228605492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748482145189922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以左旋論之，則遲者為疾，疾者為遲，日月星之一週","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228605492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"天者，皆不及天之一週耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228605492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，天動也，地静也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228621876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"日月星","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228638260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"辰麗乎天，隨天而動，故經緯錯綜而成章也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228638260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，天一","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228654644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"日而一週，日月星辰亦隨天而不動，則皆一定之物，而","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228654644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗如斯者，終古亦如斯，又安有所謂厯者哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228654644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範曰：四五紀：一曰嵗，二曰月，三曰日，四曰星辰，五曰","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228687412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"厯數。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228687412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗者，日與天㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228703796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"日一日行一度，三百六十五日","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228720180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748341740896291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"有竒而匝天一週，復與天㑹，是為一嵗，而春夏秋冬統","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228720180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"於其間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228720180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"月者，日與月㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228736564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"日一日行一度，月一日行","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228752948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"十三度有奇，二十七日有奇而匝天一週，又二日有奇","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228752948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"而與日㑹，是為一月，而晦朔弦望統於其間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228752948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"日出地","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228769332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"而為晝，入地而為夜。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228769332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"以右行論之，則為東行一度，若以","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228785716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋論之，特不及天之一度耳，亦一週也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228785716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"故合晝夜以","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228802100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"為日，而曉午昬暮統於其間矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228802100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"星者，森列之名；辰者，躔","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228818484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"次之舍。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228818484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"垣宿則附天而行，五星則遲速不一。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228834868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"天分十二","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228851252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560580658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，辰有三十度，迭運循環，週而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228851252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"是故一寒一暑以","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228867636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"為嵗，一盈一缺以為月，一明一昧以為日，一經一緯以","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228867636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"為星。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228867636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗、月、日、星紀於辰，合嵗、月、日、星、辰而為厯數，以調","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228884020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之氣，以正晦朔之期，以定晨昬之節。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228884020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"推步以稽其","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228900404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"運行，觀候以窺其躔舍，所以成嵗功而齊七政者，莫大","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228900404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"於此，故以厯數終焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228900404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"乾南，坤北，離東，坎西，震東北，兌東南，巽西南，艮西北，是","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228933172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748482145222690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"謂先天八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228933172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"離南，坎北，震東，兌西，乾、坤、艮巽，位以四維，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228949556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂後天八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228949556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"自漢以來，但知有後天而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228965940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"至焦延壽、","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228982324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"京房輩納甲卦氣之學，則又自為一家，與先、後天各不","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228982324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"相溷也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228982324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣起於中孚，有十二辟、公、侯、卿、大夫之號，古","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228998708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯家注厯皆用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101228998708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"及宋邵子乃得先天之學以傳其","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229015092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"說，則以復、姤為二至，臨、遯為二分，左右順逆，岀於畫卦","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229015092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"自然之序，與漢儒卦氣迥然兩說。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229015092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"今人因朱子本義用","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229031476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辟卦，遂誤以為邵子之說，則非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229031476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"六經論五行者，始見於禹。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229064244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"其作洪範也，一五行：一曰水，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229080628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰火，三曰木，四曰金，五曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229080628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"其告帝也，曰水、火、金、木、","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229097012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"土、穀惟修。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229097012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"其作貢也，曰六府孔修。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229113396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"皆言五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229129780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"說者謂","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229146164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"其源皆起於河圖、洛書之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229146164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"葢圖、書之一、六，水也；二、七，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229162548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"火也；三、八，木也；四、九，金也；五、十，土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229162548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"在圖則左旋而相","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229178932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"生，在書則右轉而相克也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229178932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"然土於圖、書為五、十中宫之","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229195316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"數，本無定位，無專體者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229195316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"惟吕氏月令則以土直季夏","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229211700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748482145206306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，以順相生之序。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229211700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"漢人之學，又以土直辰、戌、丑、未之","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229228084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"四季，而分旺於四時。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229228084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"要之，其說皆不可廢。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229244468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"攷文王後天","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229260852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"圖𧰼，坤、艮二土獨居夏秋冬春之交，葢火必得土而後","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229260852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"能成金，水必得土而後能生木，則土雖寄旺於四時五","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229260852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"行之間，而於此二處則其用為尤切。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229260852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"張子、朱子亦言水、","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229277236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"火非土所能制，惟木、金為土之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229277236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"其義精矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229293620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"通鑑綱目前編曰：天皇氏始制干支之名，以定嵗之所","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229326388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560564274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"在。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229326388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"爾雅曰：太嵗在甲曰閼逢，在乙曰旃䝉，在丙曰柔兆，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229342772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"在丁曰强圉，在戊曰著雍，在已曰屠維，在庚曰上章，在","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229342772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"辛曰重光，在壬曰元黓，在癸曰昭陽，是為嵗陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229342772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅曰","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229359156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"攝提格，在卯曰單閼，在辰曰執徐，在已曰大荒落，在午","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229359156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"曰敦牂，在未曰協洽，在申曰涒灘，在酉曰作噩，在戌曰","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229359156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"閹茂，在亥曰大淵獻，在子曰困敦，在丑曰赤奮若，是為","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229359156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗名。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229359156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"葢支以配地，故有定方；干以象天，故無定所。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229375540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"支干","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229391924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"相配六甲，而天道一週，是為甲厯。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229391924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"然則干支者，其厯之","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229408308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748490382721078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"所由起乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229408308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡邕獨斷云：干，幹也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229441076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"其名有十，甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、已、庚、辛、壬、","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229457460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"癸是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229457460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"○禮記月令：春月，其日甲乙，夏月，其日丙丁，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229473844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"中央土，其日戊已，秋月，其日庚辛，冬月，其日壬癸。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229473844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229490228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"註曰：乙之言軋也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229490228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"日之行，春發生萬物，月為之佐。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229506612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229522996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物皆解孚甲，自抽軋而岀，因以為日名焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229522996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"乙不為","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229539380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"月者，君統臣功也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229539380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"丙之言炳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229555764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"日之行，夏長育萬物，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229572148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748501426339850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"月為之佐。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229572148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"時萬物炳然著見而强大，又因以為日名","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229588532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229588532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"戊之言茂也，已之言起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229604916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"日之行，四時之間，萬物","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229621300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"至此皆枝葉茂盛，其含秀者抑屈而起，故因以為日","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229621300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"名焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229621300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"庚之言更也，辛之言新也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229637684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"日之行，秋成熟萬物，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229654068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"月為之佐。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229654068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物皆肅然改更，秀實新成，又因以為日","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229670452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"名焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229670452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"壬之言任也，癸之言揆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229686836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"日之行，冬閉藏萬物，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229703220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"月為之佐。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229703220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"時萬物懷任於下，揆然萌芽，又因以為日","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229719604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"名焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229719604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"○孔疏曰：律厯誌云出甲於甲，則甲，是孚甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229735988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552898936869"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"又云奮軋於乙，則乙，軋也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229752372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"又云明炳於丙，則丙，炳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229768756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"又云大成於丁，則丁，成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229785140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"又云豐茂於戊，則戊，茂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229801524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"又云理紀於巳，則已，理也，謂理正紀綱也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229817908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"又云改更","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229834292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"於庚，則庚，更也，謂物改更也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229834292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"又云悉新於辛，則辛，新","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229850676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229850676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"又云懷任於壬，則壬，任也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229867060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"又云陳揆於癸，則癸，揆","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229883444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"也，謂物之陳列可揆度也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229883444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：甲乙配東方，","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229899828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"木也；丙丁配南方，火也；戊已配中央，土也；庚辛配西","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229899828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"方，金也；壬癸配北方，水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229899828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560613426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"按：十干配五行，則五行各二；十干分隂陽，則隂陽各","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229916212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"半。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229916212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲陽木，乙隂木也；丙陽火，丁隂火也；戊陽土，已","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229932596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"隂土也；庚陽金，辛隂金也；壬陽水，癸隂水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229932596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"如鄭註","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229948980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂月為之佐者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229948980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"周子曰：陽變隂合，而生水、火、","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229965364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"木、金、土。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229965364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：五行一隂陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229981748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"其是謂歟？","logicSentenceId":"7679049101229998132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡邕獨斷曰：支，枝也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717101090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"其名一十有二，子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717117474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"未、申、酉、戌、亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717117474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：子、寅、辰、午、申、戌，為六","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717133858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552898953253"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"陽辰，以配乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717133858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、卯、巳、未、酉、亥，為六隂辰，以配坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717150242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"按：陽生於子，於律為黄鐘，是為天統。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717166626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"以次寅，為太蔟，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717183010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為姑洗；午為蕤賓；申為夷則，戌為無射，皆以陽律","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717183010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"配之，故屬陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717183010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生於未，於律為林鐘，是為地統。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717199394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"以次，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717215778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為南吕，亥為應鐘，丑為大吕，卯為夾鐘，已為仲吕，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717215778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以隂吕配之，故屬隂。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717215778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"漢書律厯誌云：孳萌於子，則","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717232162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，孶也；紐牙於丑，則丑者，紐也；引達於寅，則寅者，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717232162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"引也；冒茆於卯，則卯者，茆也，謂叢生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717232162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"振美於辰，則","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717248546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748490382786614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"辰者，振也；已盛於巳，則巳，謂陽氣巳岀而盛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717248546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"咢布","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717264930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"於午，則午者，布也；昧薆於未，則未者，昧也；申堅於申，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717264930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"則申者，堅也；畱孰於酉，則酉者，畱也；畢入於戌，則戌","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717264930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"者，入也；該閡於亥，則亥者，該也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717264930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"以四時言之，則寅、卯、","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717281314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為春；巳、午、未為夏，申、酉、戌為秋，亥、子、丑為冬。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717281314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"以五","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717297698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"行言之，則寅、卯東方木，巳、午南方火，申、酉西方金，亥、","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717297698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"子北方水，辰、戌、丑、未四維土。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717297698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"月令：孟春。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717346850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭註曰：孟春者，日月會於娵訾，而斗建寅","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717363234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717363234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"正月，三陽之月；泰，三陽之卦，故以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140717379618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"月令季冬。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718067746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭註曰：季冬者，日月會於元枵，而斗建丑","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718084130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718084130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月，二陽之月，臨二陽之卦，故以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718100514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"按史記曰：用昏建者杓，夜半建者衡，平旦建者魁。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718116898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718133282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"秋運斗樞云：第一天樞，第二璇，第三璣，第四權，第五","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718133282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"衡，第六開陽，第七搖光。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718133282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"第一至第四為魁，第五至第","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718149666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"七為杓，合而為斗。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718149666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月初昏，則用斗杓指寅；夜半，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718166050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560646194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"則用斗衡指寅；平旦，則用斗魁指寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718166050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"其日月所會","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718182434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫，謂之月將。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718182434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"娵訾，亥也；降婁，戌也；大梁，酉也；實沈，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718198818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"申也；鶉首，未也；鶉火，午也；鶉尾，巳也；壽星，辰也；大火，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718198818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"卯也；析木，寅也；星紀，丑也；元枵，子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718198818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰神后，丑曰","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718215202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉，寅曰功曹，卯曰太衝，辰曰天罡，已曰太乙，午曰","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718215202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"勝光，未曰小吉，申曰傳送，酉曰從魁，戌曰河魁，亥曰","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718215202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"登明。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718215202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"月建運天道而左旋，為天關，月將稟地道而右","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718231586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"轉，為地軸。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718231586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"四正四隅，分配八卦，是為八方。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718264354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"然正隅之間，相距尚逺。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718280738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"又以十二支象地，皆有定方。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718297122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"然十二不能均分於八方，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718313506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"惟子、午、卯、酉又正應四正之位，故以子代坎，以午代離，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718313506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"以卯代震，以酉代兌，餘則夾處於四隅。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718313506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"又以十干分五","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718329890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"行，惟戊、已配中央，餘則夾處於四正。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718329890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"合卦四，地支十二，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718346274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"天干八，共二十四，每方各三：戌乾亥也，壬子癸也，丑艮","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718346274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"寅也，甲卯乙也，辰巽巳也，丙午丁也，未坤申也，庚、酉、辛，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718346274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718379042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"分配八卦，二十四方位由是而","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718395426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"日行黃道，出入於赤道之內外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718624802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"春、秋分則正當黃、赤道","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718641186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"之交，而與地平交於卯、酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718641186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"日岀卯正，日入酉正，地平上","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718657570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"下其度相等，故晝夜適均，所謂日中、宵中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718657570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"春分以後","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718673954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"行赤道北，夏至而極北，天度分界地平上多下少，故晝","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718673954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"長夜短，所謂日𣱵也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718673954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分以後行赤道南，冬至而極南，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718690338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"天度分界地平上少下多，故晝短夜長，所謂日短也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718690338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718706722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"分前後，日行二道之交，其緯行疾，故數日而差一刻。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140718706722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813570048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748497953423371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"至前後，日行二弧之背，其緯行遲，故半月而差一刻。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813570048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813586432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗之大略也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813586432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"自京而北，夏晝較長，冬晝較短，為近北","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813602816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813602816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"若至於北極下，則赤道為地平，夏則有晝而無夜，冬","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813619200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"則有夜而無晝，此北之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813619200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"自京而南，夏晝較短，冬晝","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813635584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"較長，為近南也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813635584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"赤道之下，則赤道為天頂，冬至在南，夏","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813651968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"至在北，相去適均，則冬夏相等。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813651968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"赤道以南，則北極入地","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813668352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"下，南極出地上，冬至日去天頂近，晝反長；夏至日去天","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813668352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"頂逺，晝反短。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813668352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"若至於南極下，則赤道又為地平，冬則有","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813684736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748482145288226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"晝而無夜，夏則有夜而無晝，此南之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813684736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"南北不同，時","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813701120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"刻亦異，故各省日岀入晝夜時刻，皆以地之緯度而定","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813701120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813701120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748501426405386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63f1gm/1-SK1618_figure_00003.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QSw%2FstE84froLZK0HZ239xB4k6g%3D","pictureHeight":1003,"pictureWidth":791,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63f1gm/1-SK1618_figure_00003.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2r761FyKX7IsO%2BmArXQK7H7pgGY%3D","uri":"read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63f1gm/1-SK1618_figure_00003.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗之內，日一週天，厯十有二宫，其交每宫十五度者","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813733888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"為節，其交每宫初度者為氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813733888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"然七政之行，起於子正，有","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813750272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"今日子正尚未交，而明日子正已過者，則以三率之術","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813750272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"求之，而知其為某時刻也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813750272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"但地之經度不同，故京師為","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813766656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"午正者，自東方視之則已過矣，自西方視之則猶未及","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813766656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813766656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"是以在東者交節晚，在西者交節早。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813783040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"東西不同，時刻","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813799424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"亦異，故各省節氣時刻，皆以地之經度而定焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813799424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"日體光大，未岀之前，已入之後，距地平十八度以內皆","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813832192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"有光，是為朦景。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813832192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"然以算術推之，則十八度一也，而各時","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813848576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"各處時刻不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813848576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"各時不同者，天度使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813864960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"葢赤道當天","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813881344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"之腰，其度闊。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813881344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"自赤道而南北，漸逺則漸狹。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813897728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"故近二分者，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813914112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"朦景為時少；近二至者，朦景為時多也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813914112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"各處不同者，地","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813930496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"勢使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813930496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"近赤道則日行直，直則徑；近二極則日行斜，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"斜則紆，故愈北則朦景為時愈多，愈南則朦景為時愈","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748497953439755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"少也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"然地體渾圓，人之所處如在球面，四邊卑而中髙，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813963264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"故日出入於正東西者，其朦景短。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813963264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋分日出卯入酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813979648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"晨昏朦景各六刻五分，然其在地平下十八度，猶斜向","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813979648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"北也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813979648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"惟日道在地平下九度，與卯酉圈相交者，則在地","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813996032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"平，居卯酉圈之南，在地平下十八度，居卯酉圈之北，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813996032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"正當球面之最高。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140813996032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"故京師朦景最短之日，一在驚蟄，一","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814012416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"在寒露，晨昏各六刻四分。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814012416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"其術則半徑與赤道距天頂","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814028800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"正弦之比，同於九度正弦與距緯正弦之比也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814028800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至日","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814045184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748490382901302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"岀入偏南，其地面卑，故晨昏朦景各六刻十三分，是為","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814045184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"較長，然其在地平下十八度，則猶斜向正東西也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814045184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"既斜","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814061568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"向正東西，則猶當地平之高處，故雖長於春秋分，而猶","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814061568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"不甚長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814061568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"若夏至，則岀入皆已偏北，其在地平下十八","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814077952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"度，益斜向北，故晨昏朦景各八刻八分，是為最長。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814077952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"若地","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814094336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"愈北極愈高，日行愈斜，則夏且有晝而無夜，更不特長","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814094336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814094336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":582," {"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：五行旺各有時，惟土居無所定，乃於四立之","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814192640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"前，各旺一十八日。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814192640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：立春木，立夏火，立秋金，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814209024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬水，各旺七十二日。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814209024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"土於四立之前，各旺一十八","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814225408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"日，合之亦為七十二日。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814225408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"總三百有六十而嵗成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140814241792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"左傳曰：先王之正時也，履端於始，舉正於中，歸餘於終。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"履端於始，序則不愆；舉正於中，人則不惑；歸餘於終，事","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815060992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"則不悖。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815060992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡氏書傳曰：嵗有十二月，月有三十日，三百六","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109823010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"十者，一嵗之常數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"故日與天會而多五日九百四十","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"分，日之二百三十五為氣盈，月與日會而少五日九百","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"四十分日之五百九十二為朔虚。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"合氣盈朔虚而閏生","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"故一嵗閏率則十日九百四十分日之八百二十七，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"三嵗一閏則三十二日九百四十分日之六百單一，五","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗再閏則五十四日九百四十分日之三百七十五，十","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"有九嵗七閏，則氣朔分齊，是為一章也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"漢志曰：至朔同","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"日謂之章，同在日首謂之蔀，蔀終六旬謂之紀，嵗朔又","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748497953472523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"復謂之元。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"是故日以實之，月以閏之，時以分之，嵗以周","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"之，章以明之，蔀以部之，紀以記之，元以原之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"元法四千","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"五百六十，紀法千五百二十，蔀法七十六，章法十九。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815192064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"十九年為一章，四章為一蔀，二十蔀為一紀，三紀為一","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815192064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"元。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140815192064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"汲冢周書曰：中氣以著時，應閏無中氣，斗柄指兩辰","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893245474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"之間，故閏前之月中氣在晦，閏後之月中氣在朔。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893245474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"當閏","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893261858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，節居月中，以前作前月用事，以後作後月用事，所","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893261858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"以定四時成嵗者，不越乎此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893261858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"木長生於亥，火長生於寅，金長生於已，水長生於申，土","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"則亦長生於申，寄生於寅，葢坤艮之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"各由長生、","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893311010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴、冠帶、臨、官、帝、旺、衰、病、死、墓、絶、胎、養，順厯十二辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893311010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"按天道循環，生生不已，故木方旺而火已生，火方旺","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893311010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"而金已生，金方旺而水已生，水方旺而木已生。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893311010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"由長","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893327394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"生而順推，穉則必壯，盛則必衰，終而復始，迭運不窮，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893327394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"此四時之所以錯行，五氣之所以順布也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893327394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"至於土，則","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893343778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552899100709"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於辰、戌、丑、未，為四庫，葢水、火、木、金皆藏於土而位","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893343778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"乎中央，故易於坤曰萬物皆致養焉，於艮曰萬物之","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893343778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"所成終而所成始也，可與此互相發矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893343778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016258059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"此古今說者之所同。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893507618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"然星命家又以寅亥屬木，卯、戌屬","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893524002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"火，辰、酉屬金，子丑屬土，而午則為日，未則為月，其說不","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893524002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"同，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893524002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"葢星命家以十二宫排定上下四方，子、丑在下，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893540386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"故為土，午、未在上，故為日、為月。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893540386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、卯、辰、巳、申、酉、戌、亥分","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893556770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"布左右，則如四時之流行於天地之間，故以其左右之","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893556770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"合宫，而别為木、火、金、水之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893556770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"至於納音之五行，則有","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893573154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"以六十日之隔八相生推配為說者，又有以干支起數","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893573154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"相配及分納五音者，詳具後篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893573154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"通鑑綱目前編曰：黃帝命大撓探五行之精，占斗柄所","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893605922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"建，始作甲子，支干相配以名，而定之以納音。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893605922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"然從來言","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893622306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"五行者，以氣始形終為次，則洪範之水、火、木、金、土是也；","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893622306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"以播於四時相生為次，則月令之木、火、土、金、水是也；以","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893622306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"飭厄五材相尅為次，則禹謨之水、火、金、木、土是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893622306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"納音","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893638690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，始金、次火、次木、次水、次土，既非本其始終，又無取","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893638690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"於生尅，故說者莫知其所自來。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893638690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"今按諸術源流，無非祖","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893655074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552907210761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"述易象之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893655074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"納音之法，葢亦兼先後天之理而用之者","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893671458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893671458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"各為之圖以明之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893687842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"坎屬水，終於艮、坤屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893753378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"故始於","logicSentenceId":"7679051140893769762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
