{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748341740994595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"右圖以甲子、乙丑為金上元，壬申癸酉為金中元，庚","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894359586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"辰辛已為金下元。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894359586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"三元既周，則傳於戊子、巳丑為火","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894375970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"上元，丙申、丁酉為火中元，甲辰、乙巳為火下元。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894375970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"自此","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894392354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"以後，皆依前圖金、火、木、水、土之次，而用樂律同位娶","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894392354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"妻、隔八生子之法，以終於丁已，而納音小成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894392354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"又自","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894408738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、乙未為金上元，起如前法，以終於丁亥，而納音","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894408738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"大成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894408738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"按十干、十二支相錯為六十，五音、十二律相乘亦為","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894425122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748541079257099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"六十，故納音之法，兼二者而用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894425122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子金而乙丑亦","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894441506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"為金者，同位娶妻也；乙丑金而壬申又為金者，隔八","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894441506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"生子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894441506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"一行各三元，而後傳於次行，猶春有孟、仲、季","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894457890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"三月而後傳於夏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894457890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲子至丁已，而五行之三元","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894474274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"一周，猶易之三畫為小成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894474274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲午至丁亥，而五行","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894490658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"之三元又一周，猶易之六畫為大成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894490658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"其立法皆與","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894507042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"律吕相應。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894507042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550109872162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"甲已子、午，九；乙庚、丑、未，八；丙辛、寅、申，七；丁壬、卯、酉，六；戊","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894539810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"癸、辰、戌，五。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894539810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"巳亥屬四數。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894556194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"此揚子雲太元論聲律所紀數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894572578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"凡兩干兩支之合，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894588962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘數得四、九者，為金；得一、六者，為火；得三、八者，為","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894588962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"木；得五、十者，為水；得二、七者，為土。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894588962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子皆九，得數","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894605346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"十八；乙丑皆八，得數十六，合之三十有四，故為金。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894605346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894621730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"六申七，得數十三；癸五酉六，得數十一，合之二十有","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894621730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"四，故亦為金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894621730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘按圖推之，莫不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894638114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"但所配一","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894654498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560678962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"六、二七等數，與河圖之數不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894654498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"今按大衍之數五十，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"其用四十有九，以兩干兩支之合數，於四十九內減","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"之，餘數又滿十去之，餘一六為水，二七為火，三八為","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"木，四九為金，五十為土，各取所生之五行以為納音，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則與河圖相同。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"又揲蓍之法，用餘策以定竒偶，","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894687266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"此用餘數以定五行，其理正相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051140894687266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：樂聲是土、金、木、火水，洪範是水、火、木、金、土，即此","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099241487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"義，可以推納音之法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099241487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"天干之十，地支之十二，各屬","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099257871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"於五行，而干支錯綜之，則成花甲之六十，故有納音","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099257871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"之五行，以合干支之生化焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099257871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"葢納音者，以干支分配","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099274255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"於五音，而本音所生之五行，即為其干支所納之音","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099274255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099274255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"宫、商、角、徴、羽之五音，初以甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽干納","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099290639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748341741027363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"之，而係之以五子。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099290639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"宫聲之下得甲子，而乙丑隨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099307023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"商","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099323407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineN :null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"生為土，故庚子、辛丑納音土。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099438095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"羽聲為水，水之所生為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099454479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016356363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"木，故壬子、癸丑納音木。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099454479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"此初甲十干支所納之音也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099470863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"次以甲丙戊庚壬五陽干係之以五寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099487247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陽支之首","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099503631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"為子，其次則寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099503631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"五音之首為宫，其次則商。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099520015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"子係之天","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099536399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1098,"lineType":1,"content":"干之首為甲子，得宫，則寅係之天干之首，而次得商。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099536399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲寅得商，而乙卯隨之；納音為水，丙寅得角，而丁","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099552783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"卯隨之，納音為火。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141099552783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1102,"lineTy {"lines":[{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748501426552842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"此以八卦之六畫，分納六辰之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363335183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"凡乾在內卦則","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363351567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"為甲，而納子、寅、辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363351567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"如初九為甲子，九二為甲寅，九三","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363367951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"為甲辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363367951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"在外卦則為壬，而納午、申、戌，如九四為壬","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363384335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"午，九五為壬申，上九為壬戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363384335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"凡坤在內卦則為乙，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363400719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"而納未、已、卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363400719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"如初六為乙未，六二為乙巳，六三為乙","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363417103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363417103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"在外卦則為癸，而納丑、亥、酉，如六四為癸丑，六","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363433487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"五為癸亥，上六為癸酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363433487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"因乾坤各納兩干，故别為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363449871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"內外二卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363449871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"若震止納庚，則初九為庚子，六二為庚寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363466255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227066920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":1278,"lineType":1,"content":"六三為庚辰，九四為庚午，六五為庚申，上六為庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363466255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"巽止納辛，則初六為辛丑，九二為辛亥，九三為辛酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363482639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"六四為辛未，九五為辛巳，上九為辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363482639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離艮兌四","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363499023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，依震巽例推之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363499023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"按納甲之法，不知其所自起，因其以六卦直月，候明","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363515407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"魄死生，隂陽消息，與先天圖有相似者。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363515407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"故道書參同","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363531791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"契中所陳，本述納甲之說，而朱子以為即先天之傳","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363531791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363531791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子之後，諸儒失之，而方外之流，密相付授，以為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363548175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748488507850786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":1296,"lineType":1,"content":"丹竈之術耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363548175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1296,"lineType":1,"content":"今按先天之圖，八卦俱備，而納甲除去","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363564559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離，以為二用，則其法亦不盡合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363564559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：說卦言天地","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363580943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"定位，山澤通氣，雷風相薄，乃以三陽三隂至一陽一","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363580943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"隂為序，而其後方言水火不相射，葢以六卦寓消息，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363580943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"而以水火為用，或者古有此說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363580943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"至其參錯六辰之","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363597327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"法，則陽皆順行，隂皆逆轉，隂陽之老長中少，每差一","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363597327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"位，惟震與乾同者，長子繼父體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363597327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"坤不起於丑而起","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363613711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"於未，尤與洛書耦數起未位、後天圖坤居西南，樂律","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363613711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016405515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"林鐘為地統。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363613711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"而應未月之氣者相合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363630095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"故諸術之中，惟","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363646479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"納甲為近理。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363646479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"今火珠林卜卦即其法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363662863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"地，祭張員外文謂虎取而去來","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363826703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63kb3a/1-SK1618_figure_00010.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=H2pQvjBl6p4yXfm%2FMMgwLE%2Fg1Zc%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":553,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63kb3a/1-SK1618_figure_00010.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QkE9bVIee8tL5%2FWV7si3gh6mvlU%3D","uri":"read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63kb3a/1-SK1618_figure_00010.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748482145386530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，其徴則唐時有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363843087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅傳推東方朔龍蛇之占，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363859471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"以為變化相推，會於辰巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363859471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"又譙周謂司馬為典午，則","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363875855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"漢、晉時有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363875855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"遡而上之，晉師三豕渡河，而孔子以","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363892239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"為巳亥，葢干支相配，乙亥為一豕，丁亥為二豕，至已","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363892239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"亥則三豕也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363892239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"陳敬仲筮者言當昌於姜姓之國，而釋","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363908623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋者謂觀之六四，納得辛未，辛為巽，為長女，未為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363908623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"羊，羊加女為姜，則是周時又巳有之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363908623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"至於二十八","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363925007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"宿禽象，則近代方有之，意者因十二辰所取，而附會","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363925007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556560744498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"其説耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363925007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363941391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰以子、午、卯、酉為四中宫，故一宫","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363957775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"各筦三象。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363957775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"子宫女、虚、危，虚星居中，故為鼠之本象，女","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363974159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"為蝠，危為燕，則取其似鼠者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363974159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫氐、房、心，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363990543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"房星居中，故為兔之本象，氐為貉，心為狐，則取其似","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363990543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"兔者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141363990543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫柳星、張星居中，故為馬之本象，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364006927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"柳為獐，張為鹿，則取其似馬者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364006927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫胃、昴、","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364023311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"畢，昴星居中，故為鷄之本象，胃為雉，畢為烏，則取其","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364023311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"似鷄者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364023311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘寅、申、巳、亥、辰、戌、丑、未八宫，則","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364039695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016421899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"各筦兩象，而以近中宫者為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364039695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫亢近中宫，故為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364056079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之本象，角居其旁，則取蛟為龍之𩔖以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364056079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"尾近中宫，故為虎之本象，箕居其旁，則取豹為虎之","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖以配之；丑宫，牛近中宫，故為牛之本象，斗居其旁，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"則取獬為牛之𩔖以配之；亥宫，室近中宫，故為豬之","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"本象，壁居其旁，則取𧱬為豬之𩔖以配之；戌宫，婁近","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"中宫，故為狗之本象，奎居其旁，則取狼為狗之𩔖以","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"配之；申宫，觜近中宫，故為猴之本象，參居其旁，則取","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227099688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"猿為猴之𩔖以配之；未宫，鬼近中宫，故為羊之本象，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"井居其旁，則取犴為羊之𩔖以配之；巳宫，翼近中宫，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"故為蛇之本象，軫居其旁，則取蚓為蛇之𩔖以配之","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364072463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"其分配七曜，擇日用之，並見五卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364088847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳之年丙作首，乙庚之嵗戊為頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364121615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛更向庚寅起，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364137999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬壬位順行流。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364137999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸年從何處起，甲寅之上好推","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364154383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"求。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364154383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748541079339019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"按：上古厯元，年月日時皆起於甲子，是甲子年必甲","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364170767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"子月，為年前冬至十一月也，而正月建寅，故得丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364170767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"二月丁卯，以次順數至次年正月，得戊寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364187151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙年正","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364203535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"月起戊寅，從甲至巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364203535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"越五年共六十月花甲，週而復","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364219919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"始，故正月亦為丙寅，即甲與巳合之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364219919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳還加甲，乙庚丙作初。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364252687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛從戊起，丁壬庚子居戊","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364269071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"癸尋壬子，時元定不虚。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364269071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748497953619979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"按，甲子日起甲子時，從甲子順數至次日子時得丙","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364285455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364285455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙日起丙子，從甲至巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364301839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"越五日共六十時花甲，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364318223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"週而復始，故子時亦為甲子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364318223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰合水局。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364350991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未合木局。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364367375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌合火局。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364383759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364400143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"合金局。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364400143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"按，三合者，取生、旺、庫三者以合局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364416527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"如水生於申，旺","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364432911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"於子，墓於辰，故申子辰合水局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364432911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"木生於亥，旺於卯，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364449295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552907309065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"墓於未，故亥卯未合木局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364449295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"火生於寅，旺於午，墓於","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364465679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，故寅午戌合火局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364465679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"金生於巳，旺於酉，墓於丑，故","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364482063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑合金局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364482063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"甲與巳合，乙與庚合，丙與辛合，丁與壬合，戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364514831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"按：五合者，即五位相得而各有合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364531215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖一與六，二","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364547599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"與七，三與八，四與九，五與十，皆各有合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364547599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"以十干之次","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364563983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"言之，第一為甲，第六為巳，故甲與巳合；二為乙，七為","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364563983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556619186185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，故乙與庚合；三為丙，八為辛，故丙與辛合；四為丁，","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364563983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"九為壬，故丁與壬合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364563983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"五為戊，十為癸，故戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364580367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364596751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"一、三、五、七、九，奇也；二、四、六、八、十，偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364596751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲、丙、戊、庚、壬","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364613135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"屬陽，乙、丁、巳、辛、癸屬隂。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141364613135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"子與丑合，寅與亥合，卯與戌合，辰與酉合，巳與申合，午","logicSentenceId":"7679051141576917032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"與未合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051141576917032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：博士者，嵗之善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709589027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"掌案牘，主擬議，所居之","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709605411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"方，利於興修。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709605411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿經曰：博士者，常與奏書對衝，如","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709621795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書在艮，博士在坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709621795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：博士者，火神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709638179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227148840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"掌天子明堂，紀綱政治之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709654563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"常處於維方，不敢自","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709670947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"專也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709670947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"初起於巽者，明堂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709687331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，可進賢能，於國","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709703715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"有益。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709703715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：力士者，嵗之惡神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709736483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑威，掌殺戮。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709752867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"所居之","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709769251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"方，不宜抵向，犯之令人多瘟疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709769251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總要曰：嵗在","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709785635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，力士居東南維；嵗在南方，居西南維；嵗在西方，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709785635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"居西北維；嵗在北方，居東北維。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709785635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：力士者，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709802019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227165224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"天子之護衞羽林軍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709802019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"常居嵗前維方，不敢逺於君","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709818403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709818403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"所在之方，可詔此方之臣，以誅有罪。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709834787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：蠶室者，嵗之凶神也，主絲繭綿帛之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709867555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"所理","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709883939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可修動，犯之蠶絲不收。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709883939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：蠶室者，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709900323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"常與力士對衝。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709900323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：蠶室者，蠶神所處也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709916707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"禮","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709933091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"記云：古者天子諸侯，必有公桑蠶室，近川而為之，築","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709933091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"宫仞有三尺，棘牆而外閉之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709933091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"及大昕之朝，君皮弁素","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709949475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350260258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"積，卜三宫之夫人世婦之吉者，使入蠶於蠶室，奉種","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709949475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"浴於川，桑於公桑，風戾以食之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709949475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"又月令曰：季春之月，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709965859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"后妃齋戒，親東鄉躬桑，禁婦女，母觀省婦使，以勸蠶","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709965859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709965859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶事既登，分繭稱絲効功，以供郊廟之服，無有敢","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709982243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"惰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709982243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"如是觀之，則蠶室起於坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764709998627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"坤者，玉堂之位，后宫之","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710015011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"所，大川之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710015011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"其止巡行四維，葢取四季土位，取近","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710031395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"川之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710031395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"所在之方，天子庶民，皆可祠祀。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710047779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016536587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：蠶官者，嵗中掌絲之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710080547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，忌營構宫","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710096931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"室，犯之蠶母多病，絲繭不收。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710096931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"○黎幹曰：嵗在東方，居","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710113315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"戌；在南方，居丑；在西方，居辰；在北方，居未。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710113315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"按：蠶官者，大抵公桑蠶室之官，使蠶得養也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710129699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"如嵗在","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710146083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，屬木，木養於戌，故在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710146083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在南方，屬火，火養於","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710162467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，故在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710162467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在西方，屬金，金養於辰，故在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710178851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在北","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710195235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"方，屬水，水養於未，故在未也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710195235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748510016552971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：蠶命者，掌蠶之命神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710228003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可舉動百","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710244387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"事，犯之者主傷蠶，絲繭不收。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710244387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"○黎幹曰：嵗在北方，居","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710260771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"申，嵗在東方，居亥，嵗在南方，居寅，嵗在西方，居巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710260771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"按：蠶命者，蠶之所係以生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710277155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"如嵗在北方，屬水，水生","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710293539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"於申，故在申。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710293539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在東方，屬木，木生於亥，故在亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710309923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710326307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"南方，屬火，火生於寅，故在寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710326307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在西方屬金，金生於","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710342691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，故在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710342691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"今之蠶命，子年未，丑年午，寅年亥，卯年戌，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710359075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年巳，巳年丑，午年寅，未年申，申年卯，酉年辰，戌年","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710359075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227197992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"子，亥年酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710359075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"此恐有誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710375459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"○又按萬全廣濟云：亥子丑年，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710391843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"未坤申，寅卯辰年，戌乾亥；巳午未年，丑艮寅；申酉戌","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710391843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"年，辰巽巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710391843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"假如亥子丑年，蠶官在未，蠶室在坤，蠶命","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710408227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"在申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710408227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710424611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：太隂者，嵗后也，常居嵗後二辰，所理之地，不","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710457379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"可興修。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710457379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛書曰：嵗在四孟，則與大將軍合於四","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710473763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"仲，名曰羣醜。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710473763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：后妃所居者，后宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710490147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"后宫","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710506531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748541079371787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"之星，在帝後二星。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710506531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":380,"lineType":2,"content":"紫微垣北極五星，第二為帝星，第四為后宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"故太隂常","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710522915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"居太嵗後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710522915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"子年起戌，順行十二辰，如子年則在","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710539299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，丑年則在亥，寅年則在子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710539299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：大將軍者，嵗之大將也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710572067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"統御威武，總領戰伐，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710588451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"若國家命將出師，攻城戰陣，則宜背之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710588451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"凡興造皆不","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710604835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710604835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：孟嵗，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710621219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":392,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申巳亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"以勝光","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710621219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":392,"lineType":2,"content":"午；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"仲嵗，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710621219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":392,"lineType":2,"content":"子、午、卯、酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710621219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710621219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":394,"lineType":2,"content":"未；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"季嵗，","logicSentenceId":"7679047 {"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"按：大將軍者，統御武臣之職，有護衞虎賁之象，故居","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710686755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"四正之位，而從嵗君之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710686755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅卯辰嵗在東方，則居","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710703139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"正北。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710703139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、午未嵗在南方，則居正東。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710719523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"申、酉戌嵗在西方，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710735907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"則居正南。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710735907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、子丑歳在北方，則居正西也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710752291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經曰：嵗刑者，刑戮之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710785059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"金剛火强，各守其方，木","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710801443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"落歸根，水流趨末。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710801443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"○翼奉曰：巳酉丑，金之位，刑在西","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710817827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"方，言金恃其剛，物莫與對。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710817827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火之位，刑在南方，","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710834211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"言火恃其强，物莫與對。","logicSentenceId":"7679047764710834211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未，木之位，刑在北方，言","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757403170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"木恃榮華，故隂氣刑之，使其彫落。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757403170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水之位，刑","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757419554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"在東方，言水恃隂邪，故陽氣刑之，使不復歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757419554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"所以子","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757435938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"刑卯，丑刑戌，寅刑巳，卯刑子，巳刑申，未刑丑，申刑寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757435938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552907423753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"戌刑未，辰午酉亥為自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757435938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：嵗刑之地，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757452322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"攻城陣戰，不可犯之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757452322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"動土興工，亦須迴避，犯之多鬭","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757468706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"争。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757468706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"按：相刑之說，翼氏最明。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757485090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"葢以巳酉丑刑申酉戌，則巳","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757501474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"刑申，酉自刑，丑刑戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757501474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅午戌刑巳午未，則寅刑","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757517858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，午自刑，戌刑未也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757517858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"以申子辰刑寅卯辰，則申刑寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757534242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"子刑卯，辰自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757534242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥卯未刑亥子丑，則亥自刑，卯","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757550626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"刑子，未刑丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757550626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：嵗殺者，隂氣尤毒，謂之殺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757648930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"常居四季，謂四","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757665314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"季之隂氣，能遊天上。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757665314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：寅午戌，殺在丑，己","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757681698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556619333641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑，殺在辰，申子辰殺在未；亥卯未殺在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757681698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757698082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"厯曰：嵗殺之地，不可穿鑿、修營移徙，犯之者，傷子孫","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757698082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757698082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月殺者，三合五行成形之位，所謂","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757714466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"養是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757714466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵物之成形，母必有傷，故曰殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757730850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：劫殺者，嵗之隂氣也，主有殺害。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757763618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，忌","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757780002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"有興造，犯之，主有劫盜傷殺之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757780002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：寅午","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757796386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"戌嵗在亥，亥卯未嵗在申，申子辰嵗在巳，巳酉丑嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757796386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350374946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757796386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"義見下節。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757812770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：災殺者，五行隂氣之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757845538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"常居劫殺前一辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757861922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"主災病疾厄之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757861922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不可抵向營造，犯之者，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757878306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"當有病患。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757878306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：災殺者，三合五行胎神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757894690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"洞","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757911074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"源經曰：劫殺起於絶，災殺起於克。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757911074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"假令申、子、辰年合","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757927458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"水局，水絶於巳，故劫殺在巳，胎於午。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757927458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"又水與午火相","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757943842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，故災殺在午也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757943842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、酉、丑年合金局，金絶於寅，故劫","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757960226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350391330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"殺在寅，胎於卯；又金與卯木相尅，故災殺在卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757960226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"餘","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757976610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757976610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"按劫殺、災殺、嵗殺，是為三殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813757992994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"如曹氏說，則三合五行，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758009378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"絶胎養之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758009378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"絶胎養者，墓庫以後，長生以前，神樞","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758025762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"經所謂隂氣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758025762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂三殺者，三合五行，當旺之衝，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758042146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"故有宜向不宜坐之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758042146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰合水局，水旺於北","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758058530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"方，南方其衝也，故三殺在南方巳午未，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758058530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060146699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：伏兵大禍者，歳之五兵也，主兵革刑殺，所理之","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758091298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"方，忌出兵行師及修造，犯之主有兵傷刑戮之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758091298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758107682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"黎幹曰：寅、午、戌嵗，伏兵在壬，大禍在癸；亥、卯、未嵗，伏","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758107682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"兵在庚，大禍在辛；申、子辰嵗，伏兵在丙，大禍在丁；巳、","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758107682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、丑嵗，伏兵在甲，大禍在乙是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758107682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：伏兵","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758124066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"大禍者，以三合五行相尅之陽干為伏兵，隂干為大","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758124066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758124066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"伏兵災甚，大禍災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758140450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"然木火以其來尅者，金水則","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758156834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"以其被尅者。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758156834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金為白虎，能殺萬物，水為元武，能終","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758173218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048798258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物，故反以其所尅者為忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758173218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"按，伏兵大禍，夾處於三殺之間，如申子辰年，三殺在","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758189602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午未，伏兵大禍則在丙丁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758189602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758205986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：官符者，嵗之凶神也，主官府詞訟之事，所理之","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758238754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"方，不可興土工，犯之者，當有獄訟之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758238754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"常居嵗前四","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758255138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758255138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：嵗中掌符信之官，文權之職也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758271522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"常居","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758287906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"三合前辰，故前辰為文官，後辰為武職。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758287906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"假令嵗在寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758304290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227230760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌為三合局，則午有官符，文權也；戌有白虎，武","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758304290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"職也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758304290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758320674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：畜官者，歳中牧養之神也，主養育羣畜之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758353442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，忌造牛欄馬櫪及放牧，犯之者，損六畜傷","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758369826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758369826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：居嵗前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758386210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：畜者，養也，是","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758402594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"養畜之官，以待百官之乘驛者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758402594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"居三合前辰，與官","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758418978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"符同位。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758418978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：大殺者，嵗中刺史也，主刑鬭傷殺之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758451746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758468130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"地，出軍不可向之，併忌修造，犯者主有傷殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758468130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758484514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"總要曰：子年起子，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758484514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大殺者，是","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758500898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗三合五行建旺之辰，將星之位，名曰刺史。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758500898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"按：大殺，子年在子，丑年在酉，寅年在午，卯年在卯，辰","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758517282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"年又在子，如是逆行四正。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758517282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"葢申子辰三合為水，水旺","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758533666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"於子也；巳酉丑三合為金，金旺於酉也；寅午戌三合","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758533666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552907489289"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"為火，火旺於午也；亥卯未三合為木，木旺於卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758533666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"病符者，嵗之惡神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758566434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"主災病疫癘。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758582818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可安病","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758599202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"人，求醫藥，及有興造，犯之者，主多病患。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758599202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"常居嵗後一","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758615586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758615586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：居嵗後一辰，是言舊嵗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758631970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"新嵗將旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758648354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"舊嵗必衰，衰則病也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758648354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
