{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060163083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：死符者，嵗之凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758697506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不可營塚墓，置死","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758713890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"喪，及有穿鑿。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758713890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之者，主有死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758730274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"常居嵗前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758746658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758763042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：死符者，是太嵗自絶之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758763042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"假令太嵗在子，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758779426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"是當旺也，則丑為衰，寅為病，卯為死，辰為墓，已為絶","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758779426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758779426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758795810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：五鬼者，五行之精氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758828578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"主虚耗疾病、驚怪","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758844962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758844962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不宜興舉抵向、弔喪問病，犯之主財","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758861346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556619382793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"物耗亡，家招怪異。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758861346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：子年在辰，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758877730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：辰與子，水之精；丑與卯，木之精；未與酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758894114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"金之精；午與戌，火之精；寅申巳亥，土之精。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758894114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"謂土能生","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758910498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"育萬物，四孟為五行長生之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758910498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"故子年在辰，逆行，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758926882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"自然相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758926882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"按曹氏五行之說未確，以理求之，殆以嵗序起子而","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758943266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"順行，二十八宿起辰而逆行，順者為陽為人，逆者為隂","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758943266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"為鬼，各以其數之起處，轉而相應也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758943266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：大耗者，嵗中虚耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758976034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可營造","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758992418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"倉庫，納財物，犯之，當有宼賊驚恐之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813758992418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總要","logicSentenceId":"7679047813759008802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：常居嵗衝之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813759008802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大耗者，太嵗擊衝破","logicSentenceId":"7679047813759025186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"散之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813759025186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"物擊則破，衝則散，破散則耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891620916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：小耗者，嵗中虚耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891653684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不宜運動出","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891670068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"入、興販經營，及有造作，犯之者，當有遺亡虚驚之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891670068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748552907505673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總要曰：常居嵗前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891686452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：小耗者，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891702836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"小損也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891702836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"乃太嵗氣絶之辰，故曰小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891719220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅年，寅旺、","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891735604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"卯衰、辰病、巳死、午墓未絶也，與死符同位，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891735604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"按：小耗常居大耗後一辰，未至於大耗，故曰小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891751988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：黃幡者，旌旗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891784756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"常居三合墓辰，所理之地，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891801140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"不可開門、取土、嫁娶、納財、市買及有造作，犯之者，主","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891801140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"有損亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891801140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：黃幡者，寅午戌嵗在戌，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891817524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536168502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗在辰，亥卯未嵗在未，巳酉丑嵗在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891817524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891833908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"黃幡者，嵗君安居之位，華葢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891833908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"故取三合五行墓辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891850292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"墓者，土也，故言其黃。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891866676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經曰：將出乎中軍，葢張於","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891883060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"庫上。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891883060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891899444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"按寅午戌合火局，火墓在戌，故寅午戌嵗，戌為黄幡","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891915828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891915828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891932212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"豹尾者，亦旌旗之象，用豹尾為之，葢取所向疾速之義","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891964980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748541079404555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891964980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"常居黃幡對衝，其所在之方，不可嫁娶、納奴婢、進","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891981364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜及興造，犯之者，破財物，損小口。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891981364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：豹","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891997748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"尾者，虎賁之象，先鋒之將也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813891997748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"故常與黃幡相對，是置","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892014132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"於華葢之前也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892014132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：飛廉者，嵗之廉察，使君之象，亦名大煞。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892046900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"所理","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892063284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可興工、動土、移徙、嫁娶，犯之，主官府口舌、疾","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892063284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"病、遺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892063284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：子年在申，丑年在酉，寅年在戌，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892079668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350440482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年在巳，辰年在午，巳年在未，午年在寅，未年在卯，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892079668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"申年在辰，酉年在亥，戌年在子，亥年在丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892079668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892096052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：飛廉與大煞同義，解見第四卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892096052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"人元秘樞經曰：白虎者，嵗中凶神也，常居嵗後四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892128820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892145204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"居之地，犯之，主有喪服之災，切宜愼之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892145204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892161588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"居三合後辰，解見官符節。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892161588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048831026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"紀嵗厯曰：喪門者，嵗之凶神也，主死喪哭泣之事，常居","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892194356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892194356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可興舉，犯之者，主盜賊、遺亡、","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892210740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"死喪之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892210740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛書曰：子年在寅，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892227124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892243508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：喪門者，太嵗之轅門也，故常居嵗前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892243508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892259892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"謂喪門與白虎對衝，白虎主喪服之事，衝之故凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892259892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"紀嵗厯曰：弔客者，嵗之凶神也，主疾病哀泣之事，常居","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892292660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892292660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可興造及問病尋醫，弔孝送","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892309044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556619448329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"喪。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892309044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛書曰：子年在戌，順行十二辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892325428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"其位常","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892341812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"與官符對衝。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892341812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範篇曰：金神者，太白之精，白獸之神，主兵戈喪亂，水","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892374580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"旱淫疫。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892374580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，忌築城池，建宫室，豎樓閣，廣園林，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892390964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"興工上梁，出軍征伐，移徙嫁娶，逺行赴任。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892390964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯干神","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892407348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其忌尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892407348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿經曰：甲已之年在午未申酉，乙","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892423732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"庚之年在辰已，丙辛之年在子丑寅卯午未，丁壬之","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892423732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748556619464713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"年在寅卯、戌亥，戊癸之年在申酉子丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892423732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892440116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：金神者，以年幹五虎元厯之逢庚辛及納音金之","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892440116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"位者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892440116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲巳之年起，丙寅順行得庚午辛未，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892456500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"又壬申癸酉納音為劍鋒金，故甲巳年午未申酉為","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892456500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"金神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892456500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892472884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：五鬼者，五行之精氣也，主虚耗之事，所理","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892505652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可興舉，犯之主財物耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892505652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：甲壬年","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892522036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350456866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"在巽，乙癸年在艮，丙年在坤，丁年在震，戊年在離，巳","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892522036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"年在坎，庚年在兌，辛年在乾。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892522036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天文誌云：","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892538420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼宿有五，因以為名。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892538420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"破敗者，衝而散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892554804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"按納甲法，乾納甲壬，其衝在巽，故甲壬之年在巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892571188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"坤納乙癸，其衝在艮，故乙癸之年在艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892587572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"艮納丙，其","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892603956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"衝在坤，故丙年在坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892603956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"兌納丁，其衝在震，故丁年在","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892620340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"震也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892620340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"坎納戊，其衝在離，故戊年在離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892636724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"離納巳，其衝","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892653108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"在坎，故巳年在坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892653108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"震納庚，其衝在兑，故庚年在兌","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892669492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748541079437323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892669492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"巽納辛，其衝在乾，故辛年在乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892685876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：太嵗出遊日者，甲子日東遊，已巳日還位；丙子","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892718644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"日南遊，辛巳日還位；戊子日遊中宫，癸巳日還位；庚","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892718644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"子日西遊，乙巳日還位；壬子日北遊，丁巳日還位。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892718644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"共","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892735028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"出遊二十五日。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892735028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：太嵗諸神者，隂氣之化","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892751412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"地祗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892751412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子至已，乃陽氣健旺之辰，隂氣受制於陽","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892767796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"神，不敢用事，故假言其出遊耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892767796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060195851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"按出遊日，各以五子日幹為所往之方。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892784180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為東方木，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892800564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲子日東遊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892800564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"丙為南方火，故丙子日南遊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892816948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"庚為西","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892833332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"方金，故庚子日西遊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892833332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"壬為北方水，故壬子日北遊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892849716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892866100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"為中央土，故戊子日遊中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892866100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"五者生數之極，故各出","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892882484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"遊五日。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892882484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"共，五五二十五也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892898868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"宫音為土，商音為金，角音為木，徴音為火，羽音為水。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892931636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892948020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗遇絶位為氣絶，胎為白虎，自墓為大墓，衝墓為小","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892948020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621848985627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，尅嵗枝為害財，嵗枝來尅者為鬼賊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892948020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"同𩔖為大通，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892964404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"相生為小通。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892964404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"如宫姓屬土，長生於申，則已年氣絶，午","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892980788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"年白虎，申酉年小通，辰年大墓，戌年小墓，丑未年大","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892980788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"通，亥子年害財，寅卯年鬼賊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892980788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"商姓屬金，寅年氣絶，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892997172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年白虎，丑年大墓，未年小墓，巳、午年鬼賊，申、酉年","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892997172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"大通，辰、戌、亥、子年小通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813892997172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"角姓屬木，申年為氣絶鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893013556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"賊，酉年為白虎鬼賊，未年為大墓，丑年為小墓，辰、戌","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893013556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"年為害財，寅、卯年為大通，巳、午、亥、子年為小通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893013556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"徴","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893029940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536201270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"姓屬火，亥年為氣絶鬼賊，子年為白虎鬼賊，戌年為","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893029940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"大墓，辰年為小墓，申、酉年為害財，寅、卯、丑、未年為小","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893029940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"通，己、午年為大通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893029940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"羽姓屬水，則巳年為氣絶，午年","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893046324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"為白虎，丑、未年為鬼賊，辰年為大墓，戌年為小墓，寅、","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893046324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、申、酉年為小通，亥、子年為大通也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893046324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"起月與年同，宜","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893062708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"大通、小通月，不宜大墓、小墓月。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893062708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"然選擇修造，乆不用","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893079092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"此，存之以仍其舊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893079092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048863794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"上元甲子，男起七宫，女起五宫；中元甲子，男起一宫，女","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893111860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"起二宫；下元甲子，男起四宫，女起八宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893111860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"男逆而女順，","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893128244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"男五宫則寄二宫，女五宫則寄八宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893128244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"今以三元九星","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893144628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"例推之，則起兌七者，乃下元，非上元也；起坎一者，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893144628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"上元，非中元也；起巽四者，乃中元，非下元也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893144628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"不知傳","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893161012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"於何時。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893161012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"今隂陽家以為合婚之用，殊無理解。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893177396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"至以中","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893193780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"五配二八者，則猶坤艮屬土之說矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893193780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"御定星厯考原卷二","logicSentenceId":"7679047813893210164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：天道者，天之元陽，順理之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964490266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"其地宜興","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964506650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"舉衆務，向之上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964506650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：天道正月、九月在南","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964523034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"方，二月在西南方，三月、七月在北方，四月、十二月在","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964523034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"西方，五月在西北方，六月、十月在東方，八月在東北","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964523034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048929330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"方，十一月在東南方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964523034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"按：天道者，天德所在之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964539418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"義見下節。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964555802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：天徳者，天之福德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964588570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，所直之日，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964604954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"可以興土功，營宫室。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964604954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿經曰：天德者，正月丁，二","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964621338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"月坤，三月壬，四月辛，五月乾，六月甲，七月癸，八月艮，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964621338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"九月丙，十月乙，十一月巽，十二月庚。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964621338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964637722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"孟之月，以隂干為天徳者，是天道惠其未生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964637722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"正月","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964654106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052297738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火生而丁火未生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964670490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"四月庚金生而辛金未生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964686874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"七月","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964703258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水生而癸水未生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964703258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"十月甲木生而乙木未生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964719642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"故以","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964736026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"隂干為德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964736026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"四季之月，以陽干為天德者，是天道惠","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964752410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"其自墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964752410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"三月壬水墓，六月甲木墓。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964768794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"九月丙火墓。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964785178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964801562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"二月庚金墓。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964801562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"故以陽干為德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964817946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲之月，以四維之","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964834330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"卦為德者，是天道變化成功也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964834330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"二月萬物將生，致役","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964850714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"乎坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964850714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"五月隂氣將生，乾道變化也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964867098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"八月萬物將收，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964883482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"成言乎艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964883482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月隂氣散，陽氣入。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964899866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"巽，入也，風以散","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964916250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227312680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964916250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"按：天德者，三合之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964932634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"如正、五、九月，建寅、午、戌，合火","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964949018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"局，故以火為德。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964949018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"正月丁，九月丙，五月乾，戌火墓在乾","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964965402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964965402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"二、六、十月，建卯、未、亥，合木局，故以木為德。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964981786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"六月","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964998170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，十月乙。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678964998170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"二月坤，未木墓在坤宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965014554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"三、七、十一月，建","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965030938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、申、子，合水局，故以水為德。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965030938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"三月壬，七月癸，十一月","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965047322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"巽，辰水墓在巽宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965047322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"四、八月、十二月，建巳、酉、丑，合金","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965063706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"局，故以金為德。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965063706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"四月辛，十二月庚，八月艮，丑金墓在","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965080090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048912946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"艮宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965080090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申、巳、亥月，乃五行長生之位，故配隂干；辰、","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965096474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、丑、未，乃五行墓庫之位，故配陽干。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965096474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"子、午、卯、酉，乃五","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965112858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"行當王之位，故以配墓辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965112858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫之卦不用支而用干","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965129242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"者，支，地也，干，天也，名曰天德，故用天干。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965129242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"又用四卦以","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965145626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"代辰、戌、丑、未者，不用地支故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965145626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：月德者，月之德神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965178394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"取土修營，宜向其方，宴","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965194778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"樂上官，利用其日。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965194778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月德者，正、五、九月在丙，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965211162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227296296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"二、六、十月在甲，三、七、十一月在壬，四、八、十二月在庚。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965211162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月德者，月中之陽德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965227546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"故幹為尊，枝為","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965243930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"卑，是臣求君德也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965243930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合五行陽幹為德，假令寅、午、","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965260314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"戌三合為火，以丙為德，是各求自旺之幹為應助也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965260314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965276698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：天德合者，合德之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965309466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，宜營構宫","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965325850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"室，修築城垣，所直之日，宜覃恩賜赦，命將出師，禱禮","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965325850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052281354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"山川，祈請福願。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965325850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天德合者，正月壬，三月丁，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965342234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"四月丙，六月巳，七月戊，九月辛，十月庚，十二月乙是","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965342234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965342234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲之月，天德居四維，故無合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965358618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：月德合者，五行之精，符會為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965407770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965424154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"衆惡皆消；所直之日，百福並集。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965424154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"利以出師命將，上冊","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965440538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"受封，祠祀星辰，營建宫室。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965440538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月德合者，正、五、","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965456922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849018395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"九月在辛，二、六、十月在巳，三、七、十一月在丁，四、八、十","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965456922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"二月在乙。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965456922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
