{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：月空者，月中隂德之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965506074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，宜會親姻，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965522458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"安產室。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965522458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜設籌謀，定計策，陳剝利害，獻封","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965538842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"表章。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965538842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月空者，正、五、九月壬，二、六、十月庚，三、","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965555226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"七、十一月丙，四、八、十二月甲。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965555226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月空者，月","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965571610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536234038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"內不掌吉凶，待時而動之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965571610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"葢寅午戌月，火王用","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965587994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"事，壬水無用，亦不能克火王也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965587994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"故謂之月空。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965604378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965620762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：天恩者，施德寛下之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965653530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四禁，常開一","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965669914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"門。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965669914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為陽德，配巳成養育之功。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965686298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲配子，巳配卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965702682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"各五日而為恩也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965702682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"南方衰謝之地，無施之方，故不配","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965719066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965719066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物非土不生，故以巳土配甲成功，其日可以施","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965735450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"恩賞，布政事，恤孤惸，興宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965735450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常以甲子至","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965751834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748550227329064"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，巳夘至癸未，巳酉至癸丑，凡一十五日。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965751834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965768218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：天有四禁，子午卯酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965768218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"子為元武門，午為明堂","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965784602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"門，卯為日門，酉為月門。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965784602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"葢聖人居明堂而治天下，故","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965800986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"常開此門。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965800986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"易所謂聖人南面聽天下，嚮明而治者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965817370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為乾之納甲，巳為離之納甲。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965833754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"先天乾居正南，後天","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965850138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"離居正南，故以甲配子，巳，配卯酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965850138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"然則不配午者，以","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965866522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳皆南方卦之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965866522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"各進五辰而不及六者，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965882906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"五為君位，中央之數不可過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965882906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"故各配五日，合之成","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965899290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536283190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"一十有五，為天恩上吉日。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965899290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：天赦者，赦過宥罪之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965932058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"天之生育，甲與戊；","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965948442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"地之成立，子午寅申，故以甲戊配成天赦。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965948442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"其日可以","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965964826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"緩刑獄，雪寃枉，施恩惠。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965964826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"若與德神會合，尤宜興造。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965981210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965997594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：春戊寅，夏甲午，秋戊申，冬甲子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678965997594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679049678966013978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：天赦者，乃天之赦過宥罪之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049678966013978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"生萬物者，土","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007045642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007045642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"土之所居者，四季也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007062026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"助土而成功者，甲巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007078410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"子午者，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007094794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748488508047394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽氣爭之辰，是其罪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007094794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申者，隂陽否泰之辰，是","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007111178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"其過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007111178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"至此四辰，天道憫其罪過，故以甲巳配合，而","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007127562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"助以赦之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007127562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌者，陽土也，以甲配之，春起甲戌，秋起","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007143946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007143946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未者，隂土也，以巳配之，夏起巳丑，冬起巳未。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007160330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"皆四時長生前一辰，順數至當王之陽辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007176714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天赦為赦過之辰，則非以子午寅申為罪過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007193098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007209482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"子午寅申者，乃四時當王之陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007209482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊於十干中為","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007225866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"最尊，所謂甲為諸神之首，戊以助甲成功也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007225866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"故以配","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007242250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551483444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"其日，皆取干不克支，有上能生下之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007242250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊寅，木非","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007258634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"土不生也；甲午，木生火也；戊申，土生金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007258634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子雖非","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007275018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"相生，若戊子則以土克水，故以甲配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007275018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"且甲木生於","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007291402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，水亦生木也，故曰天赦。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007291402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳厯曰：母倉者，五行當王所生者為母倉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007324170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇土王","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007340554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"後，則以已午為之，其日宜養育羣畜，栽植種蒔。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007340554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007356938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：春，亥、子；夏，寅、卯；秋，辰、戌、丑、未；冬，申、酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007356938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"土王後，巳","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007373322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350489634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007373322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：生我者為母，積藏者為倉，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007389706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"各以生當時五行之辰為之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007406090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"按，春屬木，水生之，故以亥子為母倉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007422474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007438858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"不用","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007455242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"干而用支者，支為地，有母道焉；萬物生於土，有藏道","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007455242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007455242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：月恩者，陽建所生之干也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007488010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"子母相從，謂之月","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007504394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007504394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜營造、婚姻、移徙、祭祀、上官、納財。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007520778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052379658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"月恩者，正月、丙，二月、丁，三月、庚，四月、巳，五月戊，六月","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，七月壬，八月癸，九月庚，十月乙，十一月甲，十二月","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007537162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月恩者，子母相從，是月建反生於彼，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007553546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"葢母生我，我生子之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007553546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"按，正月寅陽木生丙陽火，二月卯，隂木生丁隂火，則","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007569930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"各從其𩔖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007569930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007586314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：生氣者，極福之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007619082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜修築城壘，開道","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007635466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052363274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"溝渠，起土修營，養育羣畜種蒔。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007635466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"如出軍戰陣，則宜背","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007651850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007651850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：生氣者，常居月建後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007668234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007684618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣者，萬物所生之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007684618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"生育萬物者，土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007701002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"土之所","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007717386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"居者，四季也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007717386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"四季者，乃四時五行所衰之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007733770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"自衰","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007750154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"然後可生彼，故以四時前季辰為生物之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007750154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"假令冬","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007766538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"水生春木，水衰於丑，生木於前，木之長生在亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007766538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"木","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007782922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"衰於辰，生火於前，火之長生在寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007782922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"火衰於未，生金","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007799306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"於前，金生於巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007799306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰於戌，生水於前，水生於申也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007815690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052396042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"皆各居其後二辰，此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007832074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"按，月建乃當王之氣，不可以衰言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007848458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"且生氣亦不耑","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007864842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"在四維之位，亦不可耑以五行之長生言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007864842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵月","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007881226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"建者，當正王之位，而前二辰已有生氣，是未旺而將","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007881226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007881226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月為三陽之月，而子則一陽己生，是為","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007897610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007897610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"可與王日、官日參看益明。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007913994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天喜者，慶喜之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007946762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜封建、宴樂、策試","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007963146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536299574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"賢良，納采問名、拜官慶賜。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007963146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春午，夏丑，秋辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007979530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"冬未。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007979530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天喜者，四時天道喜愛之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939007995914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"萬","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008012298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"物之喜愛者，無比於子母。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008012298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"謂春木生火為子，以火王","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008028682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"於午為天喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008028682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"夏火生土，土無正位，遂以火為生金，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008045066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"實四時代謝之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008045066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經云：火不克金，何王是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008061450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008077834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"以金為子，金之所居者丑，以丑為天喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008077834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金生水","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008094218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"為子，水之所居者辰，以辰為天喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008094218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"冬水生木為子，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008110602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"木之所居者未，以未為天喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008110602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"火不喜其所居，而喜","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008126986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048962098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"其王者，春氣發泄，萬物始生，未成體實而無所居，故","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008126986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"取王為喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008126986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"别隂陽家亦以所居為天喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008143370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書所載，春皆以戌為天喜，葢春木生火，火墓於","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008159754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008159754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"餘曹氏之說得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008176138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天倉者，天庫之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008208906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"其日可以修倉庫，受賞","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008225290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"賜，納財牧養。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008225290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天倉者，正月起寅，逆行十二","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008241674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008241674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：倉者，藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008258058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"月建私藏之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008274442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"葢建寅","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008290826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551516212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，天地交泰，隂陽各半而氣同，故共藏於本建。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008290826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"至","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"二月，隂陽氣離，則建事於前，私藏於後，故厯丑逆行","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"至七月，隂陽否，其氣又同，隂陽各半，亦同藏於申也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008307210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天馬者，天之驛騎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008339978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜拜公卿，擇賢良，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008356362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"宣布政事，逺行出征。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008356362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：天馬者，正月起午，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008372746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"順行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008372746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天馬者，是乾體六陽用事","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008389130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008389130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"建戌之月，剝卦直事，惟餘上九一陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008405514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"爻辭云：","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008421898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551548980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"碩果不食，是陽不可以盡剝。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008421898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"故建戌之月，復得本位，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008438282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"為乾之世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008438282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"易云：乾為天，為馬，因以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008454666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"按乾卦納子、寅、辰、午、申、戌，從初九順配之，天馬則四","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008471050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"十月在子。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008471050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"意者四月乾卦，十月建亥，又在乾宫，故以","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008487434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"配乾之初九歟？","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008487434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"與曹氏之說相發。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008503818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"又按，午為馬，故正","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008520202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"月起午。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008520202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"馬健行，故順歴六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008536586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"又天馬與白虎同，見","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008552970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"後。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008552970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052428810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：驛馬者，驛騎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008585738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜封贈官爵，詔命公卿，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008602122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"逺行赴任，移徙遷居。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008602122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：驛馬者，正月起申，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008618506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008618506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：驛馬者，五行將病，得見妻子，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008634890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"似人値困，途逢妻子者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008634890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅午戌，火也，病於申，","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008651274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"中有庚為妻，戊為子，故以申為馬。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008651274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水也，病於","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008667658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，中有丙為妻，甲為子。","logicSentenceId":"7679049939008667658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未，木也，病於巳，中有戊","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949595146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"為妻，丙為子。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949595146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑，金也，病於亥，中有甲為妻，壬為","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949611530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949611530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經云：既病見子，驛馬到來。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949627914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天醫者，天之巫醫，其日宜請藥避病，尋巫禱","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949660682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"祀。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949660682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天醫者，正月起戌，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949677066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949693450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：天醫者，三合後辰，能使萬物死而復生，損而復","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949693450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"益。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949693450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月建寅，三合為寅午戌，而戌為寅之後辰是","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949709834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949709834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949726218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：六合者，日月合宿之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949758986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜會賓客，結","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949775370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748530350522402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"親姻，立契劵，合交易。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949775370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：正月在亥，逆行十","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949791754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949791754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"按，六合者，月建與月將相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949808138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"義見第一卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949824522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經曰：三合者，異位而同氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949857290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火之三合；巳","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949873674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑，金之三合；申子辰，水之三合；亥卯未，木之三合。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949873674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜結會親姻，和合交易，修營起土，立木上梁。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949890058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949906442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：正月在午戌，二月在未亥，三月在子申，四月","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949906442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849051163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"在丑酉，五月在寅戌，六月在卯亥，七月在子辰，八月","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949906442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"在丑巳，九月在寅午，十月在卯未，十一月在辰申，十","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949906442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"二月在丑巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949906442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"按，三合者，各與其月建會，成三合局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949922826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"義見第一卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949939210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：福德者，月中福德之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949971978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜祀神祗求","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949988362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"福，願修宫室，獻封章。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954949988362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：福德常居月建前二","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950004746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950004746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：建前二辰者，是月所生之子，以其當","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950021130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748488508096546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"相氣在前為引與我能為福為德之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950021130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"故易卦以","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950037514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫爻為福德，其義一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950037514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵子能制乎鬼，使不害","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950053898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，故為福德。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950053898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月寅以火生，辰土為子，其土能","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950070282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"制水鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950070282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"二月卯木生，巳火為子，火能制金鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950086666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950103050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"月辰之衰，木能生午火為子，去制金鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950103050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950119434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"按十二地支各有所藏，若以前二辰為月建所生者，","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950135818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無不合，則生氣之在月建前二辰，亦當取此義。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950135818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599048994866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：五冨者，冨盛之神也，其日宜興舉運動，估市","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950168586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"經求。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950168586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起亥，順行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950184970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：五","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950201354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"冨者，月中餘盛之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950201354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"葢寅午戌月火王，喜亥中甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950217738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"木而生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950217738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月水王，愛巳中庚金而生。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950234122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未月","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950250506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"木王，求寅木相助。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950250506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑月金王，求申中庚金相益，","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950266890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰餘盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950266890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"767904 {"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：吉期者，吉慶之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950316042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日宜出軍行師，","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950332426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551581748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"攻城寨，興弔伐，會親姻。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950332426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前一辰","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950348810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950348810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：吉期者，是月建腹心同契之侍臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950365194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"葢常居建前一辰，可與要約吉事，故因名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049954950381578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
