{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363406390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：益後者，月中福神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130179635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜造宅舍，築","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130196019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"垣牆，行嫁娶，安產室。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130196019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月子，二月午，三月","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130212403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，四月未，五月寅，六月申，七月卯，八月酉，九月辰，十","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130212403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"月戌，十一月巳，十二月亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130212403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：益後者，於子","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130228787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣有補益之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130228787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳，為陽氣之位，以陽","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130245171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"建之月配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130245171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"午、未、申、酉、戌、亥，為隂氣之位，則以隂建","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130261555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"之月配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130261555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽會和，既生男女，當夫訓其男，婦教其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130277939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"女，使男從夫道，女從婦德，各從其道，當有益於將來，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130277939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060294155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"故云益後。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130277939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：續世者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130310707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜結婚姻，睦","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130327091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"親族，祀神祗，求嗣續。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130327091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：續世者，正月丑，二月","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130343475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"未，三月寅，四月申，五月卯，六月酉，七月辰，八月戌，九","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130343475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"月巳，十月亥，十一月午，十二月子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130343475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"按：續世者，月中繼續之神也，常在益後後一辰，葢亦","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130359859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"與玉宇金堂之相連者同意。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130359859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"○又按：自要安至續世，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130376243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748599049027634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"凡九神，其起例皆以六隂月與六陽月對衝，如正月","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130376243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，則二月申，正月卯則二月酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130376243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130392627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天后者，月中福神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130425395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜求醫療病，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130441779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"祈福禮神。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130441779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天后正月起申，逆行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130458163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130474547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：天后者，驛馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130474547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"是五行受病，復見妻子，反有","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130490931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"救助，而有食有養也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130490931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"似困而得馬，饑而得食也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130507315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"假令","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130523699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌火，以申為妻為馬，及有生戊為食也，故曰天","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130523699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649736962100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"后。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130523699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"后者，主生育萬物，為萬物之母，故因名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130540083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天巫者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130572851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜合藥請醫，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130589235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"祀鬼神，求福願。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130589235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130605619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130622003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：天巫者，月中善神，能克除鬼殺也，義與福德同。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130622003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天願者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130654771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜嫁娶納財，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130671155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"敦睦親族。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130671155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天願者，正月甲午，二月甲戌，三","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130687539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052461578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"月乙酉，四月丙子，五月丁丑，六月戊午，七月甲寅，八","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130687539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"月丙辰，九月辛卯，十月戊辰，十一月甲子，十二月癸","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130687539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"未。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130687539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天願者，乃月建枝德合神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130703923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"陽前隂","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130720307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"後，五辰各以陽干配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130720307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"四季月以隂干配之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130736691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇四","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130753075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"孟及丑、未、子、午者，無合。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130753075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂亥巳為隂陽終極之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130769459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申為隂陽否泰之辰，丑未為隂陽絶蔑之辰，子午","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130769459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"為陽消隂長之辰，故不可為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130769459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"十干巳為六賊，庚","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130785843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"為白虎，壬為元武，故不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130785843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢忌用之辰，以前","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130802227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060310539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"後近者用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130802227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月未為枝德，今忌用，取近未者。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130818611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"午以王干甲配之，得甲午也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130834995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"二月甲戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130851379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"三月乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130867763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130884147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"月丙子。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130884147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"五月忌亥，退合丑就以丁配，故得丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130900531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"六月","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130916915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"忌寅就午，六合以戊配，得戊午。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130916915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"七月否建之辰，忌丑","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130933299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"就寅，寅中有甲，從其泰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130933299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"八月忌庚用丙，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130949683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"謂金生於已，巳中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":732,"lineType":2,"content":"丙火也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"配得丙辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130949683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"九月辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130966067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"十月忌壬，以戊之陽土能","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130982451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"聚水潰，易有比卦之義，故得戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130982451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月以其自建","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130998835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"者，謂前後皆無所配。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955130998835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"然建子之月，未可假力於人，其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131015219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363439158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"忌壬用甲者，是待其子有所助也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131015219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月忌申，以就","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131031603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"近申之未，故得癸未。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131031603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"其義如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131047987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：四相者，四時王相之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131080755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜修營起工，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131097139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"養育生財，栽植種蒔，移徙逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131097139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春丙丁，夏","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131113523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳，秋壬癸，冬甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131113523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四相者，養育之道，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131129907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"母生子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131129907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"春木王，生丙丁，夏火王，生戊巳，秋金王，生","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131146291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸，冬水王，生甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131146291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"惟庚辛者，金也，能殺萬物，故不","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131162675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551647284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131162675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：四時天德者，四序中德神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131195443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜慶賜宴","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131211827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"樂，拜官賞賀。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131211827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春午，夏辰，秋子，冬寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131228211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131244595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：子寅辰午，乃東方生育之陽辰，故用事吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131244595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"申","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131260979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"戌者，西方之殺氣，故不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131260979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"各以四時所生之陽","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131277363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"辰而為之，是我生者為德也，亦名時徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131277363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"按：時德與四相同義：春木生午火，夏火生辰土，秋金","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131293747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748488508162082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"生子水，冬水生寅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131293747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"四相取天干，時德取地支。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131310131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：陽德者，月中德神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131342899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜交易開市","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131359283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"結親姻。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131359283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起戌，順行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131375667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131392051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：陽德者，乾陽之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131392051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"陽道不可以盡剝，故正月起","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131408435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，應乾之上九。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131408435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"戌者，乾之世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131424819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"又五月一隂生，即配","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131441203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"於午，順厯乾之六爻，六陽月居於寅午，戌火炎上，為","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131441203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"尊為夫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131441203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂月臨於申子，辰水潤下，為卑為婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131457587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060326923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"故所直之日，長幼有序，夫婦有别，是嘉會合禮之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131473971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"故宜如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131473971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：隂德者，月內隂德之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131506739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜施隂","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131523123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"隲，行惠愛，雪寃枉，舉正直。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131523123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起酉，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131539507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131539507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：隂德者，是月中坤隂之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131555891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131572275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"月起於酉，應坤之上六。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955131572275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，坤之世爻，故從酉逆厯","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297722394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"坤之六爻。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297722394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"坤者，厚德載物也，含弘光大，萬物資生，故","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297738778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551663668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"宜如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297738778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：解神者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297771546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜上詞章，雪","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297787930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"寃枉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297787930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正、二月，申，三、四月，戌，五、六月，子，七、八","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297804314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"月寅，九、十月辰，十一月、十二月午也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297804314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：解","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297820698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"神者，月中對奏直諫之臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297820698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"常居與月建相對之陽","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297837082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，與太嵗中奏書一義，葢忠直之臣不處私隂之位","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297837082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297837082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：六儀者，月中吉神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297869850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日宜牧養生財，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297886234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"栽植樹木，結親納禮，視事臨官。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297886234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297902618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297902618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：六儀者，月中內正禮儀，使","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297919002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建無敢私邪之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297919002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭主事，暗昧不正之神，故","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297935386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"六儀與敵衝，以威厲之，使不敢妄失儀容也，因以名","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297935386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"之，常與隂建對衝者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297935386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120430132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：時陽者，月中陽神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297968154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日宜敘婚姻，行","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297984538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955297984538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298000922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：時陽","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298017306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"者，月內掌陽氣之神，父夫之象，故陽之主事，威儀正","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298017306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"直，有禮義儀容，故其日宜敘婚姻，行宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298017306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"其起例見","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298033690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"下節。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298033690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：時隂者，月中隂神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298066458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日宜運謀算畫","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298082842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"計策，睦子孫，會親友。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298082842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298099226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298115610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536348726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭曰：時隂者，月內隂氣之神，母婦之象，故隂神","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298115610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"主事，機密不測，故其日宜運謀算畫計策，會親友，睦","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298115610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298115610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"起例常以月建加功曹。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298131994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"子上所得之辰為時陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298148378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"午上所得之辰為時隂。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298148378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"謂子者，一陽初生也，故時陽","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298164762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"取焉；午者，一隂初生也，故時隂取焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298164762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"寅者，艮方，成終","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298181146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"成始之位，三陽交泰之所，故以加之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298181146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙家常以計","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298197530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"神加和德，其義一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298197530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654010892314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：兵吉、兵福、兵寳者，皆月內用兵之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298230298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298246682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"日宜出師命將，攻伐略地。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298246682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：兵吉者，正月、子、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298263066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、寅、卯，二月、亥、子、丑、寅，三月、戌、亥、子、丑，四月、酉、戌、亥、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298263066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"子，五月、申、酉、戌、亥，六月、未、申、酉、戌，七月、午、未、申、酉，八","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298263066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"月、巳、午、未、申，九月、辰、已、午、未，十月、卯、辰、巳、午，十一月、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298263066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、卯、辰、已，十二月。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298263066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、寅、卯、辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298279450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"○兵福者，與月建同行。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298295834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"○兵寳者，月建前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298312218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：兵吉，逐月漸","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298328602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"退一辰者，是兵家無有妄進，無有躁動之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298328602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"故云：兵","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298344986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849133083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"者不祥之器，不得已而用之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298344986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"又易卦師之六四曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298361370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"師左次，無咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298361370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"言左次則為退舍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298377754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"故見可而進，知難","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298394138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"而退，師之常也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298394138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"又太白隂經曰：未見而戰，雖衆必潰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298410522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"見利而戰，雖寡必勝。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298426906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"是兵家不可以妄舉輕進，此隂","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298443290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之戒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298443290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"○兵福、兵寳者，乃當時王相之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298459674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"太白","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298476058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"陽經曰：五帝所在，不可出軍，向之必敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298476058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"春東方。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298492442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"夏南","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298508826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"方。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298508826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"秋西方。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298525210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"冬北方。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298541594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：春不東行，是謂伐生，百事不","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298557978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"成；夏不南行，是謂伐强，兵卒多殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298557978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"秋不西行，是謂伐","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298574362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363488310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"熟，兵將不復；冬不北行，是謂伐藏，士卒多傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298574362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"故月建","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298590746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"所在，為王相之方，我用而我利也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298590746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"壇經曰：王、官、相、民、守日者，皆月內視事之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298623514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"所直","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298639898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"之日，宜命將登壇，襲爵受封，上官赴任，臨政親民。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298639898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：王日者，春寅，夏已，秋申，冬亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":930,"lineType":2,"content":"今易為官日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"官日者，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"春卯、夏午、秋酉、冬子，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":932,"lineType":2,"content":"今易為王日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"相日者，春巳、夏申、秋亥、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"冬寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298656282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"民日者，春午、夏酉、秋子、冬卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298672666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"守日者，春酉、夏子、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298689050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737027636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"秋卯、冬午。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298689050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：王日者，四時正王之辰，四正","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298705434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，帝王之象，故得其政治也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298705434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"官日者，四時臨官之","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298721818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，諸侯之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298721818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"相日者，四時官日所生也，相氣之辰，宰","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298738202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"相之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298738202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"民日者，四時死絶之辰，庶民之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298754586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"守日者，四","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298770970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"時胎絶之辰，無氣能自固守，以待將來。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298770970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"各取其義以","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298787354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"為名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298787354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：天寳、天對、天玉、天岳，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298820122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":952,"lineType":2,"content":"今疑天岳非吉神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"天符、執儲皆","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298820122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536397878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"月內明星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298820122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，各宜修宫室，繕城郭，納親禮，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298836506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"進人口。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298836506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天寳者，正月起辰；天岳者，正月起","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298852890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"申；天符者，正月起戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298852890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"皆順行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298869274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"天對者，正月起","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298885658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"已；天玉者，正月起未；執儲者，正月起丑，皆順行六隂","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298885658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298885658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：此天黃道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298902042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天者，萬物之主。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298918426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"黃者，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298934810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"中央之色。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298934810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"道者，乃天皇居九重之內，出入所履之道","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298951194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故名曰天黃道。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298951194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"其神逐年月日各有所主。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298967578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"易傳云：","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298983962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"乾為天，為君，為父，是天皇之正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955298983962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"主御羣靈，司萬","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299000346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536414262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"物生死，故曰司命。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299000346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"亦能掌握萬物，故又名曰天符，今","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299016730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"皆作天府，此乾卦之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299016730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於戌，是乾之","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299033114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299033114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"其對衝巽宫，為明堂，是天皇治事之宫","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299049498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299049498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人南面而聽天下，故以巽為明堂，又名曰執儲，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299065882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"是天皇所操執，以除暴虐也，故曰齊乎巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299065882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299082266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"起於丑，是巽之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299082266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"其明堂之左，有青龍，宰","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299098650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"相之象，是震宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299098650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"震為雷，為龍，故曰青龍，又名曰雷","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299115034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"公。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299115034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於子，是震之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299131418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"其明堂之","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299147802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748628551696436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"前有朱雀，是離宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299147802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰飛流，故離為火，朱雀飛流","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299164186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299164186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於卯，是離卦初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299180570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"其明堂","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299196954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"之右，有白虎，將軍之象，又曰天棒是天皇之先驅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299196954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天馬是天皇之所乘也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299213338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於午，是震","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299229722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"卦外體之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299229722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"謂震為大臣之象，向外則為將軍","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299246106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299246106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"其天皇之右有玉堂，是天皇寢安之宫，天后之位，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299262490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"是坤宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299262490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天玉是天皇寵愛之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299278874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299295258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"於未，是坤之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299295258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇之左有金櫃，是寳藏","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299311642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737011252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"之府庫，艮之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299311642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天寳初行其道起於辰，是艮","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299328026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"卦初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299328026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇右旁有天德，兌也，是天皇施仁","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299344410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"布德喜樂之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955299344410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天對是天皇納諫聽政論道經","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469688842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"邦之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469688842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於巳，是兌之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469705226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469721610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"左旁有天刑，坎也，勞卦也，是掌刑罰之所。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469721610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：蚩尤，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469737994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"蚩尤者，虐民之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469737994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於寅，坎之初爻納甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469754378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469754378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎、天棒之後有天牢。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469770762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天獄是囚禁之所也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469787146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"配之朱雀明堂之間，葢使刑禁明而無私也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469803530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469819914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849149467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"道起於申，是坎之外體納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469819914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"故云勞乎坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469836298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469852682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"天牢之間有元武。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469852682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：隂私是邪妄之臣，故論正道","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469869066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"必有讒言，舉正直則邪妄亦進。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469869066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"易卦爻辭半君子，半","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469885450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"小人，則天下之道然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469885450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於酉，是離卦外","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469901834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"體納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469901834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"故離為朱雀，飛流皆小人之軰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469918218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"中宫之","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469934602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"位有勾陳，是天皇嬪妃之位，天帝之所居也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469934602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469950986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"道起於亥，是乾宫之隂辰，兌宫之外體納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469950986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"葢兌","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469967370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"者，說也，是天皇喜悅之宫也，故用配焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469967370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天岳疑","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469983754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654010925082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"是天獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955469983754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"岳者，山之高，地祗也，在天必無此。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470000138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"雷公本吉","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470016522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"神也，非凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470016522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"今故以天岳為天獄凶神，以雷公可","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470032906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉神。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470032906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：易卦納甲，各有逆順，今六隂之神亦順","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470049290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"者，謂奉上之禮不可以逆其情，是天道順動而無逆","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470049290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470049290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748620536430646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：青龍、明堂、金櫃、天德、玉堂、司命，皆月內天黃","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470114826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"道之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470114826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，皆宜興衆務，不避太嵗、將軍、月","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470131210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，一切凶惡自然避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470131210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：青龍，正月起子，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470147594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"金櫃，正月起辰，司命，正月起戌，皆順行六陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470147594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"明","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470163978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"堂，正月起丑，天德，正月起巳，玉堂，正月起未，皆順行","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470163978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470163978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：明堂即執儲，金櫃即天寳，天","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470180362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"德即天對，玉堂即天玉，司命即天府，其名雖異，其理","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470180362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470180362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"義見前篇。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470196746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：枝德者，地支帶德也，所直之日，宜修造築垣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470229514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470245898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：枝德者，正月在未，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470245898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"義見第二卷嵗","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470262282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"枝德節。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470262282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

Type":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：幹","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470409738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"生枝者，得其天時也；枝生幹者，得其地利也；幹克枝","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470409738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"者，得其人和，我可制彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470409738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"故幹為天為我，枝為地為","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470426122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470426122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"唐李淳風將諸家隂陽書總集一十五日，謂之大明。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470458890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470475274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748614060392459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"日宜舉動百事。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470475274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：大明者，辛未、壬申、癸酉、已","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470491658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、壬午、甲申、壬寅、甲辰、丙午、巳酉、庚戌、丙辰、巳未、庚","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470491658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"申、辛酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470491658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：不用亥、子、丑、巳四枝，乙、丁、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470508042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"戊三幹者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470508042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子、丑北方之位，隂陽始立之辰，其","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470524426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"道暗，故不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470524426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、已為隂陽極終之位，反於不顯，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470540810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955470540810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1128,"lineT ","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471065098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘庚午、戊戌、辛丑、癸卯、甲辰、庚申，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471081482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"此六日未詳其義。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471081482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"三厯撮要云：舊厯錯悞，今依官厯","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471097866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"改正。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471097866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"未審舊厯為非，新厯為是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471114250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：五合者，月內良日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471147018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜結婚姻，會親友，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471163402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"立劵交易。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471163402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：五合者，寅卯日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471179786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471196170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"十幹者，夫之象；十二支者，婦之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471196170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"今自子為始，以甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471212554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"相配，至酉而止，不及戌亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471212554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"然戌能進五辰配寅中之","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471228938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654010990618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，亥能進前五辰配卯中之乙，而成夫婦會合之禮，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471228938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰五合。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471228938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"若其他，則進五無所配也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955471245322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"c {"lines":[{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"按，厭前枝幹自相配者，為陽將，是純陽無隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689594931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"厭後","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689611315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"枝幹自相配者，為隂將，是純隂無陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689611315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"厭後幹配厭","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689627699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"前枝者，為隂陽俱將，是隂非其隂，陽非其陽，則其道","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689627699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"相乖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689627699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"葢幹為陽，當居於前；枝為隂，當從其後，是夫","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689644083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"唱婦隨之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689644083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"故厭前幹配厭後枝，為隂陽不將也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689660467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
