{"lines":[{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"一行云：鳴吠者，五姓安葬之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689971763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"用之者，得金鷄鳴，玉","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689988147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"犬吠，上下不呼，亡靈安穩，子孫冨昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955689988147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"如用破地，則於","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690004531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"其日擇克姓者。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690004531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"用○鳴吠日者，庚午、壬申、癸酉、壬午、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690020915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、乙酉、庚寅、丙申、丁酉、壬寅、丙午、巳酉、庚申、辛酉","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690020915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690020915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：金鷄者，兌也，兌宫酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690037299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"玉犬者，艮也，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690053683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748640052559882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"艮為犬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690053683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵外宅之要，在山澤地勢，是坤、艮兌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690070067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1338,"lineType":1,"content":"故以坤兌往來加艮，順布八卦，視艮所臨之辰為良","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690086451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690086451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"如兌加艮，則艮臨離，午也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690102835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"又以離加艮，則艮臨兌，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690119219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690119219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"又以坤加艮，則艮臨坤，未申也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690135603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"又以艮自加艮，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690151987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"丑寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690151987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未二辰，乃墓絶無氣之位，故不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690168371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"又十","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690184755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"幹之中，戊為陽土，以配中宫明堂之位，不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690184755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690201139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"午、甲寅、丙寅者，乃自死自旺自生之日，故不用。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690201139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"止餘","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690217523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"一十四日為鳴吠吉日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690217523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"又地理新書括地圖云：去","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690233907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654011023386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"東海有桃都山，大桃樹盤曲三千里，上有一金鷄，下","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690233907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"有二神人，一名鬱，一名壘，各持葦索，用捉不祥之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690233907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"及天將旦，日照金鷄鳴，天下衆鷄悉從而鳴。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690250291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"金鷄鳴","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690266675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"訖，下食惡鬼；金鷄鳴時，百鬼皆走避也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690266675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"一行經云：鳴吠對日者，是五姓外宅用之破土斬草也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690299443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"○鳴吠對日者，丙寅、丁卯、丙子、辛卯、甲午、庚子、癸卯、","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690315827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、甲寅、乙卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690315827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120512052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"按：鳴吠對者，乃與鳴吠對衝之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690332211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"其巳丑日無對衝，","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690348595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅與甲申，壬寅與丙申，又互為對衝，故止餘九日。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690348595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"今取十日者，葢甲午日雖不用為鳴吠，然其對衝庚","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690364979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"子，可用為鳴吠對也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690364979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲寅之對庚申，丙寅之對壬","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690381363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"申，則鳴吠日中巳用之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690381363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"惟甲午疑應作甲子，葢甲","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690397747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"子本與庚午對衝，且既用庚子，不宜井用甲午也。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690397747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"恐","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690414131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"傳者有悞。","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690414131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849215003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"御定星厯考原卷三","logicSentenceId":"7679049955690430515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63ld0m/1-SK1618_figure_00013.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l0zLkEk4nIgeNBGrW%2Bu6lhiYgFM%3D","pictureHeight":356,"pictureWidth":361,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63ld0m/1-SK1618_figure_00013.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nrgRLkQg%2FosKzczA77sZtUv5FUU%3D","uri":"read/SK1618/7/ref/1m2n89p63ld0m/1-SK1618_figure_00013.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：月建者，陽建之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118190080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，戰鬬攻伐，宜","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118206464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"背之，不可抵向。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118206464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜封建視事，不宜興造土","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118222848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"功、結親禮。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118222848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月建寅，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118239232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118255616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：月建所理之地，戰鬬攻伐，不宜向而宜背者，葢","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118255616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759560211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"使我乘旺氣而攻彼休囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118255616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，宜封建視事","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118272000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"者，建者，健也，是月內羣神之長，萬神無不咸服也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118272000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118288384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"可興造土功者，葢彼當旺勢，不可犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118288384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"其不可結親","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118304768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"禮者，是陽建獨旺，隂建氣消之辰，親禮之道，宜隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118304768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"相和，若偏則不宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118304768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"月破者，月建所衝之日也，與歳破義同。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118337536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363553846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"桑道茂曰：天罡、河魁者，月內凶神也，所直之日，百事宜","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118370304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"避。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118370304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：陽建之月，前三辰為天罡，後三辰為河","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118386688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"魁。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118386688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建之月反是。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118403072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：魁罡者，乃月建四殺","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118419456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰，平收之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118419456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"○洞源經云：對七為衝，隔三為破。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118435840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家所謂辰破丑而丑衝未，亥破寅而寅衝申，午","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118452224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"破卯而卯衝酉，酉破子而子衝午，申破已而已衝亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118452224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"戌破未而未衝丑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118452224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666140819467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：月殺者，月內之殺神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118484992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌停賔客，興穿","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118501376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"掘，營種植，納羣畜。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118501376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月殺者，正月起丑，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118517760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"四季。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118517760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：月建所刑之辰，其日忌出軍攻戰，養育生財，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118566912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"結婚姻，營造屋舍。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118566912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月刑者，正月巳，二月子，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118583296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"三月辰，四月申，五月午，六月丑，七月寅，八月酉，九月","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118583296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315567113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"未，十月亥，十一月卯，十二月戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118583296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇家書曰：寅刑","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118599680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"已，已刑申，申刑寅，為無恩之刑；未刑丑，丑刑戌，戌刑","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118599680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"未，為恃勢之刑；子刑卯，卯刑子，為無禮之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118599680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"辰午酉","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118616064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為自刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118616064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月刑者，月建之三刑也，是前","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118632448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"後三辰相尅制也，因名曰三刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118632448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"假如無恩刑者，謂巳","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118648832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"火也，賴寅木而生，反以長生之庚金制寅木也；申金","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118648832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"也，賴已火而生，反以長生之壬水制巳火也；寅木也，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118648832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"賴申中長生之水土而生，反以所生火尅申金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118648832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118665216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120593972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"子反害其母為無恩，故曰刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118665216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：寅以生火刑已","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118681600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"中生金，巳以寄土刑申中生水，申以生水刑寅中生","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118681600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118681600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"恃勢刑者，丑以墓金尅未中墓木，未以隂墓之","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118697984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"水尅戌中墓火，戌以墓火尅丑中墓金。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118697984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：丑恃癸","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118714368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"水刑戌之墓火，戌恃辛金刑未之墓木，未恃丁火刑丑","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118714368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"之墓金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118714368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"無禮刑者，謂卯中之乙，賴子為貴，子中之","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118730752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，賴卯為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118730752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"然卯以長生之巳土，刑子中之癸水，子","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118747136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"以長生之辛金，刑卯中之乙木，傷其貴徳，失其尊卑，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118747136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120610356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰無禮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118747136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"自刑者，辰之墓土，自制其墓水；午中生","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118763520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，自制其已土；酉中生丁，自制其辛金；亥中生木，自","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118763520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"制其已土，故曰自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118763520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"按月刑與歲刑同，而理解各異，兩存其説，以備互考。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118779904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"又褚華谷曰：子卯一刑也；寅已申二刑也；丑戌未三","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118796288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118796288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"自卯順至子，子逆至卯，極十數而為無禮之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118812672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"寅逆至已，巳逆至申，極十數而為無恩之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118829056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"丑順至","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118845440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，戌順至未，極十數而為恃勢之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118845440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"故皇數中天以","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118861824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120626740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"十為殺數，積數至十，則悉空其數。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118861824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"天道惡盈，滿則覆","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118878208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118878208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"此三刑之法所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118894592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦可備一說。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118910976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：月害者，陽建所害之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118943744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，忌攻城","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118960128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"野戰，牧養羣畜，結會親姻，請醫巫，納奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118960128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118976512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起已逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118976512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月害者，月中六","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118992896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912118992896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"假令卯辰相害者，卯以乙旺之木，害辰墓之土，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119009280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"辰以墓土，却害卯中癸水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119009280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"寅已相害者，謂寅以旺","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119025664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315550729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，害已中戊土，而已以生庚害寅中旺甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119025664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午相","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119042048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"害者，丑以癸水，害午中丁火；午以已土，害丑中癸水","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119042048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119042048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"子未相害者，子以所生之辛金，害未中墓木；未以","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119058432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"旺土害子中旺水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119058432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"申亥相害者，亥以生木害申中","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119074816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"生土；申以旺金害亥中生木，又以生土害亥中旺水","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119074816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119074816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌相害者，戌以墓火害酉之旺金，酉以所生丁","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119091200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"火害戌中辛金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119091200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"按六害者，不和也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119107584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事莫不喜合而忌衝。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119123968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建寅","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119140352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748621849247771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"與亥合，而已衝之，故寅與已害。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119140352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯與戌合，而","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119156736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"辰衝之，故卯與辰害。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119156736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"葢月建者，衆神之首，衝其所合，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119173120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"是以害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119173120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"按獨火與月害同，亦名遊禍，又名六害。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119205888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：月虚者，月內虚神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119238656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開倉庫，出財物，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119255040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"運動征行。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119255040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"成親禮○厯例曰：月虚者，正月起丑，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119271424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654011072538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"四季。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119271424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月虛者，月建三合五行成形之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119287808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"物初成形，其體未實，故名曰虚，與月殺同位。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119304192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：大耗者，月中虚耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119336960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌營庫藏，出","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119353344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"財物，逺經求取債負○厯例曰：大耗者，正月起申，順","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119353344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119353344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大耗者，月建擊衝破散之辰","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119369728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"也，與月破同位。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119369728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"並見第二卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119386112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666140868619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：亦月內之耗神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119418880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌經營、種蒔，納財、交","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119435264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"易。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119435264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"開市。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119451648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：小耗者，常居月建前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119468032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119484416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：小耗者，小損也，乃月建氣絶之辰，大耗之從神","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119484416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119484416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"並見第二巻。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119500800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：大時者，將軍之象也，所直之日，忌出軍攻戰，","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119533568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"築室會親。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119533568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：大時者，正月起卯，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119549952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"○淮南子曰：大時者，咸池也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119566336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大時者，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119582720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363586614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"月建三合，五行沐浴之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119582720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"葢五行至此則敗絶，是","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119599104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"最凶之辰也，故曰大凶之時。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119599104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：小時者，郎將之象也，其日忌結親姻，開倉庫。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119631872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"○淮南子曰：小時者，月建也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047912119648256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：小時者，是","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943320064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"當時之旺辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943320064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"忌結親姻者，因陽氣獨持旺氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943336448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"忌","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943352832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"開倉庫者，是旺氣發而不收也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943352832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759576595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：四廢者，四時衰謝之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943385600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌出軍征伐，","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943401984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"造舍迎親，封建、拜官，納財開市。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943401984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春，庚申、辛","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943418368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"酉；夏，壬子、癸亥；秋，甲寅、乙卯；冬，丙午、丁已。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943418368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛經","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943434752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：四廢者，是五行無氣，福徳不臨之辰，百事忌用。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943434752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943451136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"通書云：春以庚辛為廢，夏以壬癸為廢，秋以甲乙為","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943451136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"廢，冬以丙丁為廢。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943451136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"春庚辛者，而申酉亦屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943467520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"夏壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943483904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"者，而子亥亦屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943483904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"秋甲乙者，而寅卯亦屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943500288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"冬丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943516672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"者，而巳午亦屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943516672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之支干連見。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943533056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四廢","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943549440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315599881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"者，干支俱絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943549440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"假令庚申辛酉，絶於春寅卯辰也，他","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943565824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943565824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：四窮者，謂亥為隂絶之辰，以四時旺干臨之，","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943598592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰四窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943598592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"所直之日，不可逺行征伐，出納財物。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943614976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943631360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：春，乙亥，夏，丁亥，秋，辛亥，冬，癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943631360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：亥","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943647744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"者，地支末辰，極隂之位，以四時隂干配之，故曰四窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943647744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748654011088922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"總聖厯曰：四耗者，謂四時休干臨分至之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943680512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943696896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"會親姻、出師、開倉庫、施債負。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943696896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春，壬子，夏，乙","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943713280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，秋，戊午，冬，辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943713280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：物之將分者，必散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943729664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"至者，盡也，是隂陽數盡而將分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943746048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"又得休干臨之，故","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943762432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"曰耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943762432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"按：四耗日，固是休干，亦休支也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943778816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"春，壬子，幹枝皆水。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943795200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943811584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，幹枝皆木。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943811584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"冬，辛酉，幹枝皆金。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943827968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，戊午，幹土而枝","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943844352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"火。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943844352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經云：火不尅金，何旺？","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943860736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"土生金，火亦生金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943877120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943893504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120659508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"春木旺，則水耗；夏、火旺，則木耗；秋、金旺，則火土耗；冬、","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943893504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺，則金耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943893504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰四耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943909888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"按：四擊者，四時所衝之墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943959040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"如正、二、三月建寅、卯、","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943975424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，辰與戌衝，故戌為四撃也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943975424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562943991808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：五虛者，四時絶辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944024576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開倉庫，營種蒔，","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944040960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685916979215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"出財寶，放債負。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944040960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：五虚者，春、巳、酉、丑，夏、申、子、","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944057344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，秋、亥、卯、未，冬、寅、午、戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944057344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：五虚者，四時","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944073728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"逢絶之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944073728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"物絶則損朽，其中虛而無實也，故曰虚。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944090112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"如春，木旺，已、酉、丑，金絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944106496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"夏火旺，申、子、辰，水絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562944122880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947514368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺，亥、卯、未，木絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947514368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"冬，水旺，寅、午、戌，火絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947530752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"按：五虛者，三合五行絶胎養之位，與歲神三殺起例","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947547136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947547136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748671991873574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：五墓者，四旺之墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947579904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌營造、起土、嫁","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947596288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"娶、出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947596288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：五墓者，正、二月，乙未四、五月，丙戌","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947612672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"七、八月，辛丑十月、十一月，壬辰；四季月，戊辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947612672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947629056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：五墓者，五行旺干自臨墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947629056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"十干者，身之","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947645440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"象，若營造起土，似臨於無氣之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947645440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"又以干為夫之","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947661824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"象，若嫁娶，則夫自臨死氣之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947661824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"又以干為我，若出","logicSentenceId":"7679050562947678208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"軍征伐，是 {"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：九空者，月內殺神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948055040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌修造倉庫、出入","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948071424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"貨財。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948071424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：九空者，正月在辰，逆行四季。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948087808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948104192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：九空者，墓庫破散之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948104192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"庫破則空，衝則散。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948120576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948136960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"令寅午戌月，火庫在戌，辰能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948136960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未月，木墓","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948153344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"在未，丑能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948153344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月，水墓在辰，戌能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948169728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑月，金墓在丑，未能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948186112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯家所傳與九","logicSentenceId":"7679050562948 {"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917028367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天獄者，月中禁神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295872015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌獻封章、興詞訟、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295888399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"赴任征討。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295888399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：天獄者，正月在子，順行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295904783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天獄者，是三合五行胎位之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295921167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"當正","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295937551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"月起子逆行，非順行也，恐傳之者有誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295937551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"玉帳經曰：天火者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295970319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌苫葢、築壘、垣牆、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295986703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"振旅、興師、會親、娶婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857295986703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天火者，正月在子，順","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296003087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296003087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天火非天之火，是五行旺辰中","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296019471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315649033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"藏陽火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296019471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅、午、戌月在子，葢子中藏陽氣之火，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296035855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"其勢最弱，待寅、午、戌月火勢興旺，以顯其光，故子中","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296035855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"有霹靂火也，是水中之火見之於天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296035855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、卯、未月在","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296052239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，葢卯中有伏燄之火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296052239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"火氣既生於寅，至卯而木","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296068623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，反蔽其燄而成炭。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296068623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"又待亥、卯、未月木再生之，故卯","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296085007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"内有爐中火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296085007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"申、子、辰月在午，葢午中有正旺之火，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296101391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"其勢最大，物莫敢侵，其光反闇，待申、子、辰月，水勢將","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296101391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"興，反制其光，上下俱明，故午中有天上火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296101391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉、丑","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296117775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666140966923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"月在酉，謂酉中有長生丁火，如硫黄、煤炭之𩔖，故待","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296117775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"已、酉、丑月金石之氣而再發旺也，故酉中有山下之","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296117775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296117775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"且子中之陽火，卯中之木火，午中之旺火，酉中","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296134159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"長生丁火，莫非天道自然，故以名之。","logicSentenc {"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：地火者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296166927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌修築園圃，栽植","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296183311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"種蒔。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296183311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：地火者，正月起戌，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296199695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296216079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：地火者，隂奪陽也，是隂建之權勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296216079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"○天文","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296232463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748671991955494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"志曰：隂行陽之政，物傷而必尅，終以自害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296232463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"竝見月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296248847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"厭節。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296248847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：天狗者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296281615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌禱祀鬼神，祈求","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296297999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"福願。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296297999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天狗者，常居月建前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296314383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296330767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天狗者，月中禦衛之犬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296330767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"去除私邪之神，無使敢","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296347151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"侵，故居建前二辰，是禦於門首也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296347151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"自子建之月起於","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296363535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，寅者，艮之陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296363535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰艮為犬是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296379919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"祈福願祠鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296396303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315681801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"神，皆為正道，故竝忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296396303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：土符、土府、地囊，皆土神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296429071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌破土、穿井、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296445455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"開渠、築牆。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296445455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：土符者，正月、丑，二月、巳，三月、酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296461839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"四月、寅，五月、午，六月、戌，七月、卯，八月、未，九月、亥，十月、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296461839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，十一月、申，十二月子。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296461839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"○土府者，與月建同行。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296478223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"○地","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296494607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"囊者，正月庚子、庚午，二月癸未、癸丑，三月甲子、甲寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296494607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"四月巳、卯、巳、丑，五月戊辰、戊午，六月癸未、癸已，七月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296494607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748671991971878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丙申，八月丁卯、丁巳，九月戊辰、戊子，十月庚戌、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296494607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，十一月辛未、辛酉，十二月乙未、乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296494607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYi 1988262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"月建為月內萬神之主，各隨四時而運。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296609295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"葢月建之體","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296625679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"本土也，以其居，故曰府。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296625679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"○地囊者，乃土地之庫藏也，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296642063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"其義未詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296642063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：兵禁者，用兵凶辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296674831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌出師振旅、閲武","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296691215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"敎戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296691215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：兵禁者，正月起寅，逆行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296707599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296723983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：兵家所利者，隂道也，所忌者，陽道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296723983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"故兵禁","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296740367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起寅，逆行六陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296740367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"○又月令曰：孟春之月，不","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296756751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737109556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"可稱兵，稱兵必天殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296756751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"兵戎不起，不可從我始。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296773135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"故正月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296789519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅為禁辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296789519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"二月子，相行四殺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296805903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"三月戌，耗、破之","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296822287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296822287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"四月申，四殺三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296838671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"五月午，自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296855055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"六月辰，天","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296871439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"罡四殺也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296871439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"七月寅，破耗、三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296887823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"八月子，四殺、死神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296904207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"九月戌，河魁也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296920591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"十月申，六害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296936975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月午，破耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296953359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857296969743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"二月辰，四殺、天罡也。","logicSentenceId":"76790508 {"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：大敗者，兵敗忌辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412821032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌臨陣侵敵、攻城、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412837416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315698185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"野戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412837416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起卯，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412853800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412870184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"敗者，三合、五行、沐浴、休敗之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412870184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣敗絶，無以勝","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412886568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"彼，其忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412886568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲經曰：伐日者，支尅干辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412919336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌攻討征伐、出軍","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412935720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"掠地。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412935720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"○王璋曰：伐日者，庚午、辛已、丙子、戊寅、已卯、癸","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412952104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"未、癸丑、甲申、乙酉、丁亥、壬辰、壬戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412952104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：伐","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412968488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"者，彼伐於我也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412968488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬經云：干為尊，為我；支為卑，為彼。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857412984872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737125940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"是卑伐於尊，彼尅於我，其義逆也，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413001256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：專日者，謂支干五行相同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413034024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413050408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413066792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：專日者，甲寅、乙卯、丁已、丙午、庚申、辛酉、癸亥、壬子、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413066792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、戊戌、已丑、巳未、共十二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413066792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：六壬","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413083176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：幹為我，枝為彼。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413083176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"今幹枝同𩔖，是彼我同徳，兩勢","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413099560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"相敵，不分勝負，故忌出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413099560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：月厭者，隂建之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413148712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，可以禳災、祈","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413165096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"福、避病；所直之日，忌逺行、歸家、移徙婚嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413165096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413181480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭者，正月在戌，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413181480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月厭者，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413197864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"厭魅之神也，其性暗昧，私邪不正，故各忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413197864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"葢十一","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413214248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"月建子，隂陽氣争，冬至前隂氣極，冬至後陽氣生，故","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413214248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"自建子之月，陽建順厯丑寅卯一十二辰，隂建逆厯","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413214248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"亥戌酉一十二辰，至五月夏至，二氣又同建而相争","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413214248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917061135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"也，亦名曰隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413214248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"按淮南子曰：北斗之神有雌雄，十一月起運於子，月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413230632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"徙一辰，雄左行，雌右行，五月合於午謀刑，十一月合","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413230632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"於子謀徳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413230632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂所居辰為厭日，厭日不可以舉百事。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413247016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"厭對","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413263400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
