{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759658515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：往者，去也，亡者，無也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413328936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌拜官上任、逺行","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413345320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"歸家、出軍征討、嫁娶尋醫。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413345320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：往亡者，正月在","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413361704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，二月在已，三月在申，四月在亥，五月在卯，六月在","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413361704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"午，七月在酉，八月在子，九月在辰，十月在未，十一月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413361704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"在戌，十二月在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413361704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"○又氣往亡者，立春後七日，驚蟄","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413378088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"後十四日，清明後二十一日，立夏後八日，芒種後十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413378088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"六日，小暑後二十四日，立秋後九日，白露後十八日，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413378088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"寒露後二十七日，立冬後十日，大雪後二十日，小雪","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413378088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748637120708660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"後三十日，皆自交節日數之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413378088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：往亡者，往","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413394472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"而不反之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413394472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"孟者，初也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413410856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"仲者，中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413427240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"季者，末也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413443624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"葢歳","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413460008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"之始中終之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413460008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"正、二、三、四月，乃歳之初，皆以四孟","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413476392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為之，乃五行初生之地，是生氣之道往而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413476392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"五、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413492776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"六、七、八月，乃歳之中，皆以四仲辰為之，葢四仲者，五","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413492776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"行當旺之辰，是旺氣之道往而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413492776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"九、十、十一、十二","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413509160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"月，乃歳之終，皆以四季辰為之，謂四季者，乃五行終","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413509160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"墓之地，是萬物皆歸往而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413509160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"又氣往亡者，以四立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413525544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737158708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"月往亡之辰三合化象之成數言之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413525544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413541928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"春，寅為往亡，寅午戌合火局，火之成數七也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413541928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"四月立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413558312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，卯為往亡，亥卯未合木局，木之成數八也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413558312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"七月立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413574696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，酉為往亡，已酉丑合金局，金之成數九也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413574696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"十月立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413591080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"冬，未為徃亡，土無化象，便以本行土為之，其成數十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413591080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413591080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"各倍之為次月往亡日；三之為下月往亡日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413607464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"獨","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413623848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"水數不用者，葢四立之月往亡無申子辰日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413623848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"然一","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413640232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"歳之內，四季之月，以辰為首，辰月以申為往亡，申合","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413640232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666141016075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"水局，水之成數六也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413640232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"故三月中氣後六日，九月中氣","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413656616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"後十二日，各得往亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413656616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"六月則土旺後二六一十二日，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413673000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月土旺後三六一十八日，亦得往亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413673000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"或節氣加","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413689384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"時，早晚間有差一日者，然其理大槩如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413689384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"○通書云：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413705768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"唐太宗曰：宋武帝以往亡起兵，軍吏以為不可。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413705768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"帝曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413722152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"我往彼亡，果克之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413722152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"由此言之，可廢明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413738536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：歸忌者，月內凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413771304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌逺行、歸家、移徙、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413787688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315747337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"娶婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413787688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：孟月丑，仲月寅，季月子。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413804072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413820456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"子者一陽，丑乃二陽，寅乃三陽，葢此三辰，陽氣始盛，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413820456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"主動於外，不可反歸於內也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413820456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"按：孟月忌丑，仲月忌寅，季月忌子者，皆忌退後一辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413836840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂歸忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413836840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"如子為仲，丑為季，寅為孟，故孟月忌退","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413853224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"歸於季，仲月忌退歸於孟，季月忌退歸於仲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413853224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：章光者，隂建前辰也，其日忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413885992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413902376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748671992021030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"常居隂建前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413902376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：章光者，能為月厭，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413918760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"彰顯其道，故曰章光。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413918760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：無翹者，翹猶尾也，陽烏所主，隂則無之，常居","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413951528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"厭後，故曰無翹，其日忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413951528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：翹猶首翹，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413967912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人之飾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413967912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"無翹者，是無其飾也，故忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857413984296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：咸池招搖八風觸水龍所直之日，忌乘船渡","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414017064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748674315763721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"水、涉江河。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414017064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：咸池者，正月起卯，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414033448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"招","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414049832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"搖者，正月起辰，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414049832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"八風者，春，丁丑、已酉；夏，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414066216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、甲辰；秋，辛未、丁未；冬，甲戌、甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414066216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"觸水龍者，丙子、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414082600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑、癸未也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414082600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：咸池者，三合五行沐浴之","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414098984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，是陽建之浴地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414098984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"五行至此，皆值沒溺，其忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414115368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"招搖者，動而不安，隂建之衝也，故與六儀同行。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414131752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"又天","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414148136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"文志有招搖之星，在梗河亢池之左，角亢之次，辰宫","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414148136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故正月起辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414148136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"八風者，是八節八卦之風也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414164520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"各以四","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414180904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666141048843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"立之建後一辰為四立之風，以其三合前辰，為次節","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414180904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"風。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414180904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"如立夏建已，以辰為立夏風也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414197288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"申為三合前辰，為","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414213672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至風是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414213672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"假令立春建寅，以建前丑為正風，以丁","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414230056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"配之，取溫和之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414230056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"以酉為傍風，配之以已，取已土","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414246440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"長生之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414246440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"立夏建已，以辰為正風，申為傍風，皆以","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414262824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"甲配之者，立夏之後，風勢極微，故配甲以生之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414262824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"立","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"秋建申，以未為正風，而不取傍風者，謂秋氣好殺，而","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"無養育之性，以辛配之，取金風之象；又以丁配之，存","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759674899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"其溫和之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬建亥，以戌為正風，寅為傍風，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414295592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲配之者，以風鳴冬，其勢極大，配之以甲木以生","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414295592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"風也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414295592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"共為八節，故曰八風。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414311976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"觸水龍者，觸，犯也，龍，水物","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414328360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414328360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"壬、癸、亥、子，水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414344744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"能與水相勝者，火土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414361128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"火在上為","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414377512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，土居下為四季，辰乃龍之正位，壬水所居戌亥為","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414377512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"乾天之位，有龍𧰼焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414377512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"故惟餘丙子、癸未、癸丑為觸水","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414393896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"龍日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414393896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917093903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要經曰：血忌血支，其日忌針刺出血。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414426664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：血忌","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414443048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"者，正月丑，二月未，三月寅，四月申，五月卯，六月酉，七","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414443048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"月辰，八月戌，九月已，十月亥，十一月午，十二月子。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857414443048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"血","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521872930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"支者，正月在丑，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521872930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：血支者，氣","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521889314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"血之支流也，故起於旺建之後，生氣之前，如人生之","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521889314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"後，自有血脈，暢於四肢，若其日針刺者，是去其血也，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521889314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521889314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"血忌者，以人之血脈出入往來，一噓一吸，運","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521905698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"動不息，故一厯本位，一居其衝，亦隂陽各相配之義","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521905698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666141081611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521905698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"故建陽之月則厯於丑寅卯辰巳午陽氣之位；建","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521922082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"隂之月則厯於未、申酉戌亥子隂氣之位，與續世義","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521922082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521922082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"正月與血支同起於丑者，正月隂陽交泰，血氣通","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521938466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"和，然後流布於四肢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521938466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：官符者，其日忌拜官視事，上表章，陳詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521971234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521987618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：官符者，正月起午，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857521987618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522004002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"官符者，是歳月中掌符信之官，文權之職也，常居三","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522004002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363635766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"合前辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522004002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵歳辰月建，以其三合前辰為文官，後辰","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522020386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"為武職，是左文右武之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522020386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月建寅，則午上有","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522036770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"官符，文權也；戌上有白虎，武職也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522036770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"併見第二卷。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522053154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：天吏者，月中凶神也，其日忌臨官赴任，逺行","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522085922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522085922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天吏者，正月起酉，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522102306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522118690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：天吏者，三合五行死氣之位，五行至此死而無","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522118690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，乃天之凶吏，全無生意也，其忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522118690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：臨日者，上臨下之義也，其日忌臨民訴訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522151458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522167842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：臨日者，正月午，二月亥，三月申，四月丑，五月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522167842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，六月卯，七月子，八月已，九月寅，十月未，十一月辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522167842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522167842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：臨者，上臨於下也，是陽建之","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522184226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"使臣，奉上命以授百官者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522184226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"建陽之月在三合前辰，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522200610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"是臨於文官官符也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522200610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"建隂之月在三合後辰，是臨於","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522216994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"武職白虎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522216994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天賊者，月中盜神也，其日忌逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522249762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522266146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天賊者，正月在丑，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522266146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天賊","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522282530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"者，盜神也，常居天倉後辰，葢倉庫之後必有盜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522282530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"壇經曰：牢日、獄日，徒隷死别，伏罪不舉罪刑，其日皆不","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522380834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"宜臨官視事，登壇受職。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522380834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：牢日者，春辰、夏未、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522397218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"秋戌、冬丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522397218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"獄日者，春未、夏戌、秋丑、冬辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522413602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"徒隷者，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522429986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"春申、夏亥、秋寅、冬巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522429986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"死别者，春戌、夏丑、秋辰、冬未","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522446370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522446370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"伏罪者，春亥、夏寅、秋巳、冬申也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522462754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"不舉者，春子、夏卯、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522479138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"秋午、冬酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522479138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"罪刑者，春丑、夏辰、秋未、冬戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522495522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522511906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363652150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：牢日者，四時衰謝之辰也，衰在墓地，故曰牢。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522511906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"獄","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522528290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"日者，四時墓辰也，入於墓，故曰獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522528290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"徒隷者，是四時五","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522544674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"行絶辰也，置之於卑賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522544674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"死别者，以其將死而又歸","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522561058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"於墓，是四時五行死辰之墓也，如春屬木，死於午，午","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522561058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"為火，戌為火墓是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522561058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"伏罪者，是子見其母也，葢為子","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522577442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"有罪，父母責之，故云伏罪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522577442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"不舉者，是四時五行沐","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522593826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"浴之辰，似初沐浴而未冠帶之象，不可舉薦於上人","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522593826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinY {"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天刑、朱雀、白虎、天牢、元武、勾陳者，月中黑道","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522855970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522855970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，所直之日，皆不可興土功，營屋舍，移徙","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522872354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"逺行，嫁娶出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522872354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：天刑者，正月起寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522888738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522905122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"者，正月起午。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522905122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"天牢者，正月起申。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522921506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"皆順行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522937890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522954274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"者，正月起卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522954274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"元武者，正月起酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522970658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳者，正月起亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857522987042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"皆","logicSentenceId":"76790508575230034 {"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748649737207860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：八龍、七鳥、九虎、六蛇，其日皆不可迎婚嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523052578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：春甲子、乙亥為八龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523068962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"夏丙子丁亥為七鳥。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523085346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"秋庚子辛亥為九虎。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523101730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"冬壬子癸亥為六蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523118114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523134498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：亥者，隂氣之極，子者，陽氣初生。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523134498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"是隂陽氣絶，脱謝","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523150882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523150882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"十干象夫，十二支象婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523167266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"今以四時旺干而配","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523183650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子，是夫旺而婦絶，且我臨於絶地也，故忌用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523183650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"按：甲乙者，東方木也，為青龍，其成數八。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523200034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁者，南方","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523216418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"火也，為朱雀，其成數七。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523216418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛者，西方金也，為白虎，其","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523232802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748696373362703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"成數九。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523232802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸者，北方水也，為龜蛇，其成數六。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523249186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"故各因","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523265570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"以為名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523265570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"金櫃經曰：乙者，雷電始發之日；戊已者，北辰位下之日；","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523298338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"辛者，萬物決斷之日；壬者，三光不照之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523298338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"子、午、卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523314722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲之辰，日月之門，隂陽之界。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523314722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"五干臨此四辰，其日","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523331106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"不可出軍、嫁娶、移徙、築室。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523331106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹植曰：九醜者，乙卯、已","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523347490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、辛卯、乙酉、巳酉、辛酉、戊午、戊子、壬午、壬子。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523347490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523363874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748721077813286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：卯酉為日月出入之門，子午為隂陽交争之界。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523363874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"乙為六合，辛為太陽，壬為元武，已為六賊，戊為勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523380258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"故此五干加此四辰，名曰醜。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523396642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"又以五干四辰，其共數","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523413026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"九，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523413026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經曰：八專日，忌出軍嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523445794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹植曰：八專者，丁未、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523462178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未、庚申、甲寅、癸丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523462178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"按，六壬日辰課體訣曰：甲寄居寅乙寄辰，還將丙戊","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523478562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705760247842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"巳宫尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523478562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"未支丁巳藏功用，申地庚金作主盟。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857523494946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"辛在戌","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693839412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"宫癸寄丑，壬干原寄在登明。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693839412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"二盤四正無差錯，運式","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693855796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"通靈動鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693855796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"葢即十干祿辰，除子、午、卯、酉四正不用，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693872180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"故移於辰、戌、丑、未，而各取其干支所配之日，是為八","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693872180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"專。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693872180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"今六壬三傳起例用之，如甲祿在寅，卯不用，故乙","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693888564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"在辰，辰中亦有乙木也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693888564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"丙、戊祿在巳，午不用，故丁巳","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693904948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"在未也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693904948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"庚祿在申，酉不用，故辛在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693921332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"壬祿在亥，子不","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693937716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"用，故癸在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693937716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"相配止有五日，以其干支比和，故為専。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693954100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748630363684918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"同専日取義，以十二支除四正不用，餘八，故為八専","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693970484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857693970484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：五離者，月中離神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694003252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌結婚姻，會親友，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694019636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"作交闗、立契劵。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694019636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：五離者，申酉日是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694036020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694052404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：五離者，是隂陽重會之辰也，再合則離，義見","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694052404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"月吉神五合節。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694052404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759805971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：重日者，以隂陽混合於亥，陽起於甲子而順，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694085172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"隂起於甲戌而逆，至巳亥而同，故曰重日。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694085172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌為","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694101556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"凶事，利為吉事。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694101556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：重日者，已亥二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694117940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694134324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：亥為隂極之位，坤辟在焉；已為陽極之位，乾","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694134324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"辟在焉，是陽中陽而隂中隂也，故曰重。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694134324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌為凶","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694150708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"事者，恐重犯也；利為吉事者，宜再見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694150708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：復日者，為魁罡所繋之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694183476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌為凶事，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694199860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748666141130763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"利為吉事。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694199860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：復日者，正七月甲庚，二，八月乙","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694216244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":1138,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，四，十月丙壬，五，十一月丁癸，三，九六，十二月戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694216244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694216244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：復者，重見也，為本建之辰，與所遇","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694232628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"之干同也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694232628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月寅即甲也，而又見甲，是復也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694249012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694265396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰戌即戊也，丑未即巳也，而又見戊巳，是復也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694265396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"餘","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694281780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694281780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"又地理新書云：正月甲，七月庚，二月乙，八月辛，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694298164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":1148,"lineType":1,"content":"四月丙，十月，壬，五月，丁，十一月，癸。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694298164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":1148,"lineType":1,"content":"三月、九月，戊，六月、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694314548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月，巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694314548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門經曰：離者，隂陽分至前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694347316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"謂建卯之月，陽氣","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694363700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":1158,"lineType":1,"content":"出，隂氣入；建子之月，隂氣降，陽氣升；建酉之月，隂氣","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694363700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"出，陽氣入；建午之月，陽氣降，隂氣升。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694363700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"故先一日為四","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694380084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"離辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694380084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：此日忌出行征伐。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694396468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694412852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"四離者，冬至前一日，水離；夏至前一日，火離；春分前","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694412852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"一日，陽體分而木亦離也；秋分前一日，隂體分而金","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694412852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"亦離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694412852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"故名曰四離。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694429236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門經曰：四絶者，四立前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694462004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：此日忌","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694478388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"出軍逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694478388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：立春，木旺水絶；立夏，火旺木","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694494772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"絶；立秋，金旺土絶；立冬，水旺金絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694494772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"故先一日為絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694511156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：長星者，正月，初七，二月，初四，三月，初一，四月，初","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694543924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"九，五月，十五，六月，初十，七月，初八，八月，初二、初五，九","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694543924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"月，初三、初四，十月，初一，十一月，十二，十二月。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694543924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"初九是","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694560308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748660759838739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694560308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"○短星者，正月，二十一。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694576692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"二月、十九。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694593076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"三月。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694609460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"十六。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694625844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"四月，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694642228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694642228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"五月，二十五。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694658612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"六月，二十。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694674996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"七月，二十二。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694691380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"八月，十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694707764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"八、十九。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694707764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"九月，十六、十七。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694724148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"十月，十四。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694740532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月，二十二，十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694756916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"二月二十五日，是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694756916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開市、納財、立券、交易、裁","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694773300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"衣。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694773300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：長者，過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694789684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"短者，不及也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694806068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"凡開市、納財、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694822452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"立券、交易、裁衣，皆貴乎中平適宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694822452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"若或過或不及，其","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694838836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694838836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"葢長短星者，金火也，謂金火之氣，能毁傷萬","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694855220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"物也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694855220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970517004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"按：長星者，庚辛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694871604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏用庚，秋冬用辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694887988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"陽取陽，隂取","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694904372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694904372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"以月建內所寄之干，四季則用四時隂干，依五","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694920756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"虎元遁得庚辛者，自建辰向前數之，春夏至庚則止，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694920756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬至辛則止。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694920756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"其本節所當之卦，則取其宫數。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694937140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"如春","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694953524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"月，則以卯為震三，四月則以巳為巽四，其餘辰，則一","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694953524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"辰當一得數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694953524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正月建寅，寅中有甲，以甲遁","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694969908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"得庚午，自寅一震，三辰，一巳一午一共，得七數，故七","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694969908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"日為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694969908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，卯中有乙，以乙遁得庚辰，自","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694986292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970533388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"卯之震三，併辰一共四數，故四日為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857694986292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"三月建","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695002676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，辰中無所寄，就乙仍遁得庚辰，止得一數，故一日","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695002676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695002676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"四月建巳，巳中有丁，以丁遁得庚戌，自巳","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695019060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"之巽四，厯午、未、申、酉、戌，共九數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695019060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"午不用離九者，以","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695035444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"巳用巽四故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695035444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"五月建午，午中有丙，以丙遁得庚寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695051828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"為丙火長生之位，故向前得庚子。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695051828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"自離九厯未、申、酉、","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695068212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥、子，得一十五也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695068212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"六月建未，就丁遁得庚戌，自未","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695084596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"申厯酉之兌七，至戌共得一十也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695084596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"用兌七者，以六月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695100980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748696373395471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"為金氣伏藏之時，故用西方之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695100980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"七月建申，申中","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695117364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"有庚為同體，又以秋冬用辛，故不用遁辰而用旺辰","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695117364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"之酉，自申至酉之兌七，共得八數也；八月建酉，酉中","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695117364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"有辛，故即得兌七也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695117364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"今為二日、五日，合之亦得七。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695133748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"九","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695150132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"月建戌，就辛遁得庚子、辛丑，自戌至子得三，自戌至","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695150132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"丑得四也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695150132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"不用宫數者，以戌尚西方之令，未至於乾","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695166516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695166516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"十月建亥，亥中有癸，遁得辛酉，謂干支同體，故用","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695182900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"壬遁得辛亥，故止得一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695182900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月建子，子中有壬，遁","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695199284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117120553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"得辛亥，故自子之坎一至亥得十二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695199284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月建丑，","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695215668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"就癸遁得辛酉，自丑至酉得九也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695215668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"不用宫數，與九月","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695232052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695232052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"○短星者，丙丁也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695248436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏用丙，秋冬用丁，陽取陽，隂","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695264820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"取隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695264820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"各以月建內所寄之干，四季則用四時，隂干","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695281204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"依五子遁得丙丁者，自建辰向前數之，春夏至丙則","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695281204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"止，秋冬至丁則止，其本節所當之卦，則取其宫數，其","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695281204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"餘辰則一辰當一，得數于朔實二十九日內減之餘","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695281204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695281204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正月甲遁得丙寅，寅為艮八，以減二十","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695297588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917159439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"九，餘二十一，故二十一日為短星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695297588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"二月乙遁得丙","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695313972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，自卯之震三至戌得一十，以減二十九，餘一十九","logicSentenceId":"7679050857695313972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNu {"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：甲已在艮乙庚乾，丙辛坤位喜神安。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522639908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬寄向離","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522656292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"宫坐，戊癸還依巽上看。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522656292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大抵物之所喜","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522672676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"者，母見子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522672676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲已化土生金為子，金之所居者，","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522689060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"丑也，丑近於艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522689060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛化水生木為子，木之所居者，未","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522705444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748727402987583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"也，未近於坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522705444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸化火生土為子，土居於辰，近於","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522721828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522721828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金生水為子，水居於辰，辰既有土，故居","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522738212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"於乾，乾為亥子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522738212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化木生火為子，火旺於午，離","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522754596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522754596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"按，物以相見為喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522770980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"易傳曰：相見乎離。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522787364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"離者，南方之卦","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522803748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522803748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"於五行為火，於十干為丙。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522820132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"喜神者，見丙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522836516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522852900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"巳之干用五虎，元起丙寅，寅為艮，故在艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522852900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚之","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522869284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"干得丙戌，戌為乾，故在乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522869284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之干得丙申，申為","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522885668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917208591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"坤，故在坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522885668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬之干得丙午，午為離，故在離也。","logicSentenceId":"76790502315229 {"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"按：日有六十，宿有二十八，四百二十日而一週。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522951204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"四百二","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522967588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"十者，以六十與二十八俱可以度盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522967588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"故有七元之","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522983972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"説。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231522983972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"一元甲子日起虚，以子象鼠，而虚為日鼠也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523000356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"二元","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523016740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子起奎。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523016740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"三元甲子起畢。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523033124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"四元甲子起鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523049508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"五元甲子","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523065892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"起翼。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523065892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"六元甲子起氐。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523082276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"七元甲子起箕。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523098660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"至七元盡，而甲","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523115044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748727402954815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"子又起虚，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523115044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"但一元起於何年月日，則不可","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523131428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"得而考矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523131428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
