{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"虛、昴、星、房，為太陽蚤日。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523164196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"危、畢、張、心，為太隂莫日。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523180580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"室、觜、翼、","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523196964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"尾，屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523196964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"壁、參、軫、箕，屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523213348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"奎、井、角、斗，屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523229732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"婁、鬼、亢、牛，屬","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523246116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"金。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523246116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"胃、柳、氐、女，屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523262500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰禽象，以二十八宿之列於十二宫者配之，既見","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523295268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970582540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"首卷，又有以十二象分隂陽者，子前四刻為昨夜之","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523295268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，後四刻為今日之陽，猶冬至前為隂，冬至後為陽","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523295268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523295268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"故鼠前足四爪，後足五爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523311652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"丑屬隂，故牛蹄分。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523328036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"寅屬","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523344420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，故虎五爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523344420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"卯屬隂，故兔缺唇，且四爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523360804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"辰屬陽，故龍","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523377188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"五爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523377188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"巳屬隂，故蛇舌分。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523393572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"午屬陽，故馬蹄圓。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523409956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"未屬隂，故","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523426340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"羊蹄分。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523426340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"申屬陽，故猴五爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523442724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"酉屬隂，故鷄四爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523459108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"戌屬陽，","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523475492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"故狗五爪。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523475492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"亥屬隂，故猪蹄分。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523491876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970598924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中空亡者，甲子旬中，戌、亥空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523524644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌旬中，申、酉空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523541028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523557412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中，午、未空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523557412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午旬中，辰、巳空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523573796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰旬中，寅、卯空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523590180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523606564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"寅旬中，子、丑空。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523606564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"按十日為旬，以十干配十二支，自甲至癸而止，餘二","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523622948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"辰天干不及，故為空亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050231523622948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子起至癸酉止，不及","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163656747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥，故甲子旬十日皆以戌、亥為空。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163656747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163673131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"截路空亡者，甲已日，申、酉時。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163705899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚日，午未時；丙辛日，辰","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163722283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705915469851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"巳時；丁壬日，寅卯時；戊癸日，子丑時。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163722283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"按截路空亡，遇壬、癸也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163738667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"行路而遇水，則不可行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163755051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163771435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"甲已日以五鼠遁起，甲子順厯之，得壬申、癸酉，故甲","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163771435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日以申酉為截路空亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163771435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163787819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：冬至，公中孚，始辟復，侯屯，內小寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163820587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"侯屯外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163836971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163853355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"謙，卿睽。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163853355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"大寒，公升，辟臨，侯小過，內立春。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163869739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"侯小過外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163886123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163902507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"夫䝉，卿益。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163902507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"雨水，公漸，辟泰，侯需，內驚蟄。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163918891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"侯需外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163935275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163951659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917224975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"隨，卿晉。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163951659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"春分，公解，辟大壯，侯豫，內清明。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163968043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"侯豫外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374163984427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164000811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"訟，卿蠱。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164000811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"糓雨，公革，辟夬，侯旅，內立夏。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164017195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"侯旅外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164033579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫師，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164049963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"卿比。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164049963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿，公小畜，辟乾，侯大有，內芒種。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164066347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"侯大有外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164082731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164099115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"夫家人，卿井。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164099115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至，公咸，辟姤，侯鼎，內小暑。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164115499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"侯鼎外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164131883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164148267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"夫豐，卿渙。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164148267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"大暑，公履，辟遯，侯恒，內立秋。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164164651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"侯恒外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164181035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164197419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"節，卿同人。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164197419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"處暑，公損，辟否，侯巽，內白露。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164213803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"侯巽外。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164230187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164246571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"萃，卿大畜。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164246571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分，公賁，辟觀，侯歸妹，内寒露。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164262955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"侯歸妹；外","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164279339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫无妄，卿明夷。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164279339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"霜降，公困，辟剝，侯艮；內立冬，侯艮；","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164295723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117251625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"外大夫既濟，卿噬嗑。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164295723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"小雪，公大過，辟坤，侯未濟；內大","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164312107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"雪，侯未濟；外大夫蹇，卿頤。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164312107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"按五等用卦，皆出於漢儒焦延夀、京房之説，所謂卦","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164328491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164328491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯無之，姑存於此。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164344875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：三伏者，四時代謝，皆以相生。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164377643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"立春以木代水，水","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164394027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"生木也；立夏以火代木，木生火也；立冬以水代金，金","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164394027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"生水也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164394027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"至於立秋，以金代火，金畏火尅，故至庚日則","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164410411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748696373461007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"必伏藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164410411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"庚者，金也，金氣伏藏，則火益熾。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164426795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"三，陽數也，故","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164443179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至後第三庚為初伏，第四庚為中伏，立秋後初庚","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164443179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"為末伏，謂之三伏。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164443179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"如夏至日得庚，便為初庚；立秋日","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164459563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"得庚，亦即為末伏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164459563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"孝經緯曰：社者，土地之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164492331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"封土為社，以報土功也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164508715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164525099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：二分前後，近戊為社。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164525099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：勾龍共工，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164541483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"能平水土，祀以為社。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164541483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"后稷能殖百榖，祀以為稷。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164557867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"社為","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164574251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970631692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"土神，稷為穀神。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164574251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"今以二分之氣祭者，謂春分萬物發","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164590635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"生，百穀將種，所以祈也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164590635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分萬物成熟，百穀將收，所","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164607019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"以報也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164607019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"自元旦日干順數至幾日逢辛日者，即為得辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164639787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"自元旦","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164656171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"日支順數至幾日逢辰日者，即為幾龍治水。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164656171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"按：朔者，日月交會之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164688939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"月本無光，借日光以為光。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164705323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"逺","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164721707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748727403069503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"則光顯，近則光隠。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164721707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"合朔，日月同宫近度，故不見月。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164738091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164754475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"復南北同度，則日為月所蔽，而日為之食矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164754475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"故日食","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164770859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"在朔。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164770859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"按：上弦者，周天四分之一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164803627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"月猶銀丸，受光含影。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164820011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"自合","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164836395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"朔後，去日漸逺，日照其西，故自下視之，如銀鉤然，是","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164836395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"三日而哉生明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164836395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"至初八日間，去日九十度，日照其","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164852779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"半，西明而東暗，如弓弦之平分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164852779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"因自虧而向盈，故","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164869163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705915502619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"曰上。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164869163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"按：望日者，日月相望之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164901931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"日月相衝，日在地下，月在","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164918315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"天上，相距六宫，對照而光滿。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164918315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"若南北同度，則月值暗","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164934699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"虚，恰為地影所隔，而月為之食矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164934699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"故月食在望、","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164951083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"按下弦者，周天四分之三也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374164983851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"自望而後，去日漸近，日照","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165000235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"其東而西虧，是望後哉生魄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165000235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"至二十三日間，西去","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165016619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748685917257743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"日二百七十度，東去日九十度，日照其半，東明而西","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165016619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"暗，亦猶上弦之平分，皆所謂近一而逺三也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165016619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"因自盈","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165033003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"而向虧，故曰下","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165033003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"按：晦日者，月之盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165065771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"去日甚近，將與日合，其光晦隠而","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165082155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"不見。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165082155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"至朔則既合而光復生。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165098539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"朔者，蘇也，月死於晦，而","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165114923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"復蘇於朔也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165114923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"故晦日百事不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165131307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"○又厯例曰：晦朔弦","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165147691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"望之辰，忌服藥療病。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165147691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：晦朔、弦日者，陰氣","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165164075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748727403036735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"不足之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165164075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"望日者，隂奪陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165180459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"故其日忌服藥療病。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165196843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"滅日　沒日","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165213227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：滅、沒日，忌療病服藥。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165229611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：滅日者，積朔","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165245995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"虚分而為之；沒日者，積氣盈分而為之，非天地之全","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165245995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165245995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"故其日忌療病服藥。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165262379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"按滅日、沒日，見於漢書，詳載於授時厯，今厯無之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374165278763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"通書云：俗忌初五、十四、二十三年，年月月在人間。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272724998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"其法","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272741382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117268009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"以五黄土值日相配，廉貞火，生起中宫之土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272741382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"每月","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"初一日起一白水入中宫，與貪狼木相配，水木相生","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"也；初二日，二黑土與巨門土相配，比和也；初三日，三","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"碧木能制綠存土也；初四日，四綠木與文曲水相生","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"也；初五日，五黄土配廉貞火，火生土旺，火晦土湮而","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"已。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272757766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"初十、十九，又數一白貪狼，至十四、二十三，又值五","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272774150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"黄廉貞，此俗忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272774150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"按：九宫之次，自一白至九紫。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272790534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"九星之次，則一貪狼，二","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272806918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748727403053119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門，三祿存，四文曲，五廉貞，六武曲，七破軍，八左輔，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272806918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"九右弼，故其相配如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272806918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"又以其日為九五之數，自初","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272823302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"一至初五，五數也；自初五至十四，自十四至二十三，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272823302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"皆距九日。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272823302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"世不敢用，假言其忌，故曰俗忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272839686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：人神者，人之神識也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272872454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"其逐日所在，忌用鍼灸。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272888838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：人神者，非人之神識也，是六氣隂陽所","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272905222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"在表裏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272905222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"黄帝內經靈樞經、甲乙經所載：一日，足大","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272921606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748721077977126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"指厥隂分刺灸之，發跗腫。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272921606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"二日，外踝少陽分刺灸之，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272937990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"陽經筋緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272937990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"三日，在股少隂分刺灸之，小腹痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272954374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"四日，腰","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272970758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽分刺灸之，腰僂無力。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272970758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"五日，在口太隂分刺灸之，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272987142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"舌强。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374272987142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"六日，兩手陽明分刺灸之，咽喉不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273003526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"七日，內踝","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273019910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"少隂分刺灸之，隂經筋急。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273019910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"八日，手腕太隂分刺灸之，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273036294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"腕不收。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273036294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"九日，在尻厥隂分刺灸之，主多病結。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273052678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"十日，腰","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273069062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"背太陽分刺灸之，腰背僂。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273069062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"十一日，鼻柱陽明分刺灸","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273085446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"之，齒面腫。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273085446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"十二日，髮際少陽分刺灸之，令人耳重聽。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273101830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705760313378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"十三日，牙齒少隂分刺灸之，氣寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273118214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"十四日，胃腕陽明","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273134598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"分刺灸之，氣脹。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273134598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"十五日，遍身不補不瀉，刺灸大禁。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273150982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273167366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"六日，在胷太陽分刺灸之，主逆息。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273167366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"十七日，氣衝陽明","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273183750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"分刺灸之，喘息。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273183750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"十八日，在股少隂分刺灸之，隂氣痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273200134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"十九日，在陽明分刺灸之，發腫。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273216518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"二十日內踝少隂分，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273232902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"刺灸之，經筋𤼣。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273232902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"二十一日手小指太陽分，刺灸之，手","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273249286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"不仁。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273249286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"二十二日足外踝少陽明分，刺灸之，經筋緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273265670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273282054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"十三日肝及足厥隂分，刺灸之，發轉筋。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273282054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四日手","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273298438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748701117317161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"陽明分，刺灸之，咽中不利。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273298438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五日足陽明分，刺灸","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273314822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"之，胃氣脹。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273314822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"二十六日在胷太隂分，刺灸之，令人喘咳。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273331206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"二十七日在膝陽明分，刺灸之，足脛厥逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273347590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八日","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273363974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"在隂少隂分，刺灸之，小腹急痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273363974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"二十九日膝脛厥隂","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273380358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"分，刺灸之，筋痿少力。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273380358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"三十日陽明分，月空亡，不瀉不","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273396742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"治，故以其所在，謂之人神","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273396742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"通書云：甲辰、乙巳、庚辰、辛巳、丙申、戊戌、丁亥、已丑、壬申、","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273789958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，此十日祿皆落空，故云無祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273789958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲祿在寅，乙祿","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273806342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"在卯，甲辰旬，寅卯空，故甲辰、乙已為無祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273806342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"庚禄在","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273822726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"申，辛祿在酉，甲戌旬，申酉空，故庚辰、辛巳為無祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273822726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊祿在已，甲午旬，已空，故丙申、戊戌為無祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273839110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273855494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"已祿在午，甲申旬，午空，故丁亥、巳丑為無祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273855494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"壬祿","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273871878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748721078026278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"在亥，甲子旬，亥空，故壬申為無祿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273871878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"癸禄在子，甲寅","logicSentenceId":"7679051374273888262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":652, {"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705915551771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"卿大夫用歳對之日，以建王所衝為之。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433026089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"如春三月建王","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433042473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"東方寅卯辰，衝在西方申酉戌，故春三月以秋為歳","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433042473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"對也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433042473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：過為行狼，不及為了戾，不合為孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433140777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433157161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748719970664460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：三月陽建於辰，隂建於申，陽前不及於丙，隔於","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433157161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"巳也，後過於甲，隔於卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433157161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"故以甲配申則不從，以丙","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433173545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"配申不及，以戊庚壬配申則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433173545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲申為行狼，丙","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433189929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"申為了戾，戊申、庚申、壬申為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433189929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"四月陽建於已，","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433206313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建於未，陽前不及於丁，隔於午也；後過於乙，隔於","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433206313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433206313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"故以乙配未則不從；以丁配未則不及，以已辛","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433222697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"癸配未則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433222697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙未為行狼，丁未為了戾，巳未、辛","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433239081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"未、癸未為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433239081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"九月陽建於戌，隂建於寅，陽前不","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433255465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748734436769844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"及壬，隔於亥也；後過於庚，隔於酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433255465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"故以庚配寅則","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433271849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"不從，以壬配寅則不及，以甲丙戊配寅則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433271849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"故庚","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433288233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為行狼，壬寅為了戾，甲寅、丙寅、戊寅為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433288233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433304617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"月陽建於亥，隂建於丑，陽前不及癸，隔於子也；後過","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433304617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"於辛，隔於戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433304617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"故以辛配丑則不從；以癸配丑則不","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433321001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"及；以乙丁巳配丑則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433321001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"故辛丑為行狼，癸丑為了","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433337385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"戾，乙丑、已丑、丁丑為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433337385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月建者，陽","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433353769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"也；月厭者，隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433353769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主干，隂主支。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433370153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"若得陽建前後近干","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433386537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350748705915568155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"以配隂建者，大會也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433386537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"若以陽建後隔位之干配隂建","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433402921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"者，為行狼不從，乃陽氣不從也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433402921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"陽建前隔位之干配","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433419305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建者，為了戾不及，是陽氣不及也。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433419305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"以隂建左右之","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433435689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"干自配者，為孤辰，非其正應，隂自配也，故曰不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433435689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"單隂","logicSentenceId":"7679051374433452073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":910,"lineType":2,"content":"自單隂至純陽四位，皆以時無大會，故以戊已配月建為之。出堪輿經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
